jobs.description:
Full Time

Closing Date: 30 Sept 2026

Location: Remote (timezone: UTC -1 to UTC +5).
Compensation: Peek benchmarks annual salary based on market ranges per jurisdiction. To learn the hiring ranges for this position, please review the Application Instructions below.

The Role

Division: Delivery

Team: Training & Support; Meet the Peek Team.
Travel: up to 20% travel per annum
Working Day: Flexible working hours throughout the week. Daily collective overlapping hours are 11:00-16:00 UTC. Our Full Time work week is approximately 40 hours.

The Learning Experience Designer (LXD) plays a critical role in improving partner and customer capability, confidence and product adoption through exceptional learning experiences.

Working as part of the Partner & Customer Enablement team, you will lead and drive the end to end learning experience from learner research and discovery through to design evaluation and continuous improvement ensuring learning evolves alongside our software and our user needs. You'll translate subject matter expert (SME) authored content into engaging, learner-centred experiences that make technical concepts simple, accessible and easy to apply.

Working closely with the Head of Partner and Customer Enablement, Partner and Customer Enablement Leads, Product teams, Clinical Leads, Partnership teams and our Learning Platform Specialist, you'll design scalable learning solutions that support onboarding, product adoption and ongoing capability development. Success in this role means creating learning experiences that measurably improve learner confidence, customer adoption and organisation outcomes, while establishing high standards for learning quality, governance and continuous improvement across our learning ecosystem.

Peek’s staff are distributed internationally around the globe and our customers and software users operate and deliver programmes in multiple countries. Travel to programmes using Peek in different countries will be part of the role (in line with Peek’s Travel Safety Policy).

Responsibilities and Attributes

The key responsibilities of the role are:

  • Design engaging digital, blended and face-to-face learning experiences - including learner journeys, onboarding programmes, certification pathways, assessments and supporting resources - that improve user capability, confidence and product adoption. Exploring and responsibly apply AI-assisted learning design to improve quality, efficiency and content operations
  • Design the learner experience from technical and SME authored content, defining the learning journey and approaches as source assets ready for hand over to instructional design and digital development.
    Align learning journeys with strategic enablement models e.g. Trainer of Trainers & Partner as Trainer, with the Head of Partner and Customer Enablement and develop internal enablement resources that build capability across our teams.
  • Apply evidence-based learning experience design principles, adult learning theory e.g. Knowles, Kolb, ADDIE and accessibility standards e.g. WCAG to create engaging and inclusive learning.
    Design and develop inclusive, multilingual learning for global audiences, adapting content with support from translation services to meet different levels of literacy, digital literacy, English language proficiency and cultural context.
  • Conduct learner research, needs analysis and skills gap analysis to inform learning design decisions, aligning research methods, frameworks and best practices with product design colleagues.
  • Define measurable learning outcomes and use learner analytics, evaluation frameworks and customer feedback to continuously improve learning effectiveness and product adoption.
  • Audit learning content and ecosystems and develop standards, templates, frameworks and governance processes that improve information architecture, content quality, consistency, discoverability and scalability.
  • Partner with SMEs and cross-functional stakeholders to facilitate content discovery, learning design workshops and content reviews; coach Partner and Customer Enablement Leads on learner-centred design principles and effective knowledge transfer; and work closely with product design and our Instructional Designer through build, testing and iteration to shape learning experiences across the product, including integrating learning and product design principles across UX, microcopy and in app content.

The key attributes we have identified for the role are:

  • Experience in Learning Experience Design or Curriculum Design, with an education background, teaching qualification and experience as a trainer or facilitator.
  • Extensive experience transforming SME-authored content into engaging learner-centred and build ready content for LMS, in-app guidance, chatbot experiences, instructor-led training, workshops and hands-on software training - including for global audiences with low literacy, low digital literacy and limited English proficiency.
    Strong curriculum design, lesson planning, storyboarding and learning documentation skills with excellent learning content writing that simplifies complex technical concepts, strong visual communication and attention to detail.
  • Strong grounding in adult learning theory and learning experience design methodologies (e.g. ADDIE, Kolb Experiential Learning), with experience designing assessments, knowledge checks and certification programmes, and applying learner research, analytics and evaluation frameworks to measurable outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating with Product Design or UX teams in a software organisation — comfortable reading designs and prototypes (e.g. Figma, Claude Design) and working within an established design system.
  • Excellent written communication, facilitation, stakeholder management and relationship-building skills with proven collaboration in multidisciplinary teams, a learner-first mindset and a proactive, self-motivated commitment to continuous improvement.

Desirable attributes for the role are:

  • Experience using AI-assisted learning design and content development tools
  • Experience creating multimedia learning using authoring tools
  • Experience supporting organisational change management initiatives.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • BA or MA in Education, Applied Linguistics or a related discipline.
  • Experience with SafetyCulture LMS or similar learning platforms.

About Peek

Millions of people worldwide are losing their sight unnecessarily. We are intent on changing this. Join a mission-driven award winning team who are intent on changing this.

  • Vision and eye health for all - Why Peek exists and the problem we solve
  • What is Peek? - How our product works
  • Kiyasi’s Story - A short film about some of the people who use and benefit from our tools
  • WIRED - How Peek Vision Helped 1.5 Million People to See Again
  • Rolex Perpetual Planet Initiative - Andrew Bastawrous: Global Vision
  • Peek team members often say that working here is more than just a job — it's a chance to make a real impact alongside supportive, mission-driven colleagues.

More than one in eight people worldwide can’t see clearly. By 2050, the number of people affected is expected to double. There aren’t enough eye health specialists to treat everyone, and at the same time many people are invisible to eye health services or never make it to care. Peek Vision is a social enterprise that exists to help eye care services reach everyone who needs them.

Our software and data insights platform helps to optimise and evaluate eye health services working in schools, communities and workplaces.

  • Peek supports eye health from planning through to screening and treatment with:
  • Population-level rapid assessments
  • App-based vision screening
  • Data capture and referrals
  • Real-time service monitoring and insights

By 2050, we aim to prevent 1.25 billion people from needlessly losing their eyesight.

We are dynamic, impact-driven and award-winning. Our products have been developed in collaboration with eye health providers, professional bodies and researchers. They reflect global best practices in health systems decision-making.

Peek is powering eye health programmes in multiple countries. One person is screened with Peek every four seconds.

Why work at Peek?

Our team is united around one goal: vision and eye health for all. Your work will have tangible impact, creating lasting improvements in eye health worldwide.

We are a team like no other - our diverse, multidisciplinary team is recruited from a wide range of backgrounds, including technology development, public health, research, eye health, international development and the private sector. Peek promotes a high level of ownership and accountability within each role, with frequent collaboration between team members and across teams. Peek’s culture promotes individual ownership, accountability and collaboration across and within teams, with team leads playing a supportive role in wellbeing, development and prioritisation.

Working for Peek Vision provides a number of benefits - to find out more about our approach to compensation and benefit provision, please visit our Why work at Peek? page on our website.

Application Information & Instructions

This includes internships, temporary roles, consultancy, or volunteer assignments. Remote Employee BPO has an outstanding opportunity for you!


﻿

Role: ﻿SQL Server Database Administrator (Azure-Hosted Environment)

Compensation: Competitive Basic Salary

Benefits: HMO plus 2 Free Dependents, P1,500 Rice Allowance.

Work Schedule: 5-day work week, 10:00 p.m. 7:00 a.m. Philippine time

Work Setup: Work From Home

﻿

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced SQL Server Database Administrator to join our engineering team. In this role, you will own the health, performance, and integrity of our database infrastructure across both on-premises and Azure environments. A core focus of this position is building and maintaining automated data quality and accuracy monitoring systems — ensuring our data pipelines stay clean, consistent, and trustworthy at scale. You will partner closely with developers and product managers to deliver reliable data solutions that power our customer-facing products.
﻿
﻿﻿

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

Design and drive elegant solutions to complex backend and data architecture challenges.

Own data quality end-to-end — build automated validation pipelines, anomaly detection routines, and reconciliation processes that proactively surface data accuracy issues before they reach customers.

Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate monitoring, alerting, and remediation workflows across the data platform.

Evaluate tooling and technologies to shape the future of our data infrastructure — we value open-minded, forward-thinking approaches.

Leverage the full Azure ecosystem — including Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Automation Accounts — to streamline and modernize backend operations.

Collaborate with product managers and development teams to build and support new customer-facing features. Contribute to continuous improvement of backend data processes and database DevOps practices.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES


Database Administration

﻿

  • Manage and administer SQL Server databases across on-premises and Azure environments.
  • Configure, maintain, and optimize database servers and associated processes.
  • Monitor system health and performance; proactively identify and resolve issues in real time.
  • Ensure high levels of availability, performance, sustainability, and security across all database systems.
  • Execute scheduled maintenance and support after-hours release deployment activities as needed.
  • Partner with the Senior DBA to scope and close out database-related projects.




Data Quality & Accuracy Monitoring

﻿

  • Design and implement automated data validation frameworks to continuously verify accuracy, completeness, and consistency across databases and data pipelines.
  • Build alerting and reporting systems that flag data anomalies, unexpected nulls, referential integrity violations, or statistical drift in near real time.
  • Develop reconciliation routines that cross-check data between source systems, staging layers, and downstream consumers.
  • Create and maintain data quality dashboards and audit trails to support operational visibility and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to define data quality SLAs and enforce them through automated controls.

﻿

Automation & Scripting

  • Automate recurring maintenance tasks, monitoring checks, and remediation workflows using PowerShell, Python, and SQL Agent jobs.
  • Refine and document automation scripts; maintain version control via Git.
  • Support database CI/CD pipelines and schema migration tooling in collaboration with DevOps.

Development Collaboration

  • Assist developers with query tuning, schema refinement, and resolution of concurrency (deadlock) issues.
  • Optimize stored procedures and functions in collaboration with the development team.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS


Core Database Skills

  • Proven experience in a SQL Server DBA or equivalent role.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Proficiency with SQL Server 2016+ (2019,2022 and/or 2025 strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated expertise in Performance Tuning and Optimization (PTO).
  • Solid knowledge of backup strategies, restore procedures, and recovery models.
  • Experience implementing High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions for SQL Server.
  • Experience with SQL Server Data Replication and Clustering.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server CLR assemblies.
  • Experience administering Windows Server environments, including Active Directory.






Data Quality & Automation

  • Experience building or maintaining automated data validation, reconciliation, or data quality monitoring systems.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for database automation, alerting, and administrative workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Python for data quality scripting, pipeline automation, or ETL support.
  • Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics workspaces, and alert rule configuration.
  • Understanding of data quality dimensions: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.

Professional Skills

  • Strong sense of ownership with a commitment to quality and its impact on business outcomes.
  • Excellent analytical and critical problem-solving skills under pressure.
  • Collaborative team player with strong time-management and communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with dbt (data build tool) or similar data transformation/testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, or Microsoft Fabric for pipeline orchestration.
  • Experience with Great Expectations, Soda, or custom-built data quality frameworks.
  • Knowledge of database security features: Dynamic Data Masking, Always Encrypted, Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), and row-level security.
  • Experience with database CI/CD tooling such as Flyway, Liquibase, or Redgate.
  • Elasticsearch experience.
  • Microsoft certifications: MCTS, MCITP, DP-300 (Azure Database Administrator Associate), and/or MVP designation.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice Provost for Accreditation & Accreditation Liaison Officer
jobs.excerpt: Job Description:Position SummaryThe Assistant Vice Provost for Accreditation & Accreditation Liaison Officer (AVP/ALO) provides strategic leadership and day to day operational oversight for the Office of Accreditation, Licensure & State Authorizations (ALSA).
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Position Summary

The Assistant Vice Provost for Accreditation & Accreditation Liaison Officer (AVP/ALO) provides strategic leadership and day to day operational oversight for the Office of Accreditation, Licensure & State Authorizations (ALSA). This position directs all institutional and programmatic accreditation activity, oversee state authorization and licensure compliance across every state in which the institution operates, and serves as the institution's official liaison to its institutional accreditor and to all programmatic accrediting and approval agencies. The AVP/ALO manages a team of functional Coordinators covering Accreditation, Licensure, and State Authorizations, reports to the Vice President for Academic Affairs, and serves as a key advisor to the Executive Cabinet on accreditation, licensure, and regulatory compliance matters.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

General Oversight

  • Responsible for all functions of ALSA, including regulatory compliance, planning, and budget for the office.
  • Leads and manages all institutional and programmatic accreditation efforts across the institution's campuses and modalities.
  • Responsible for all state authorization and reauthorization efforts to ensure compliance across all states in which the institution operates.
  • Responsible for institutional licensure compliance activity, including audits and disclosures across applicable state licensing boards.
  • Serves as advisor to the Executive Cabinet on changes affecting accrediting bodies and state and local approving entities.
  • Prepares accreditation affairs updates, including quality enhancement plans, process development, compliance certification, assessment, analysis, and reporting.
  • Promotes institutional policies and procedures in compliance with local, state, and federal rules and regulations; advises personnel on regulatory strategy, areas of regulatory concern, and new regulatory developments.
  • Monitors U.S. Department of Education (ED) policy and regulatory changes to ensure ongoing institutional compliance.
  • Monitors state authorization and licensure changes across all states in which the institution operates.
  • Develops short- and long-range plans, conceptual designs, and documentation related to accreditation, assessment, licensure, and state authorization.
  • Reviews activity, operations, and forecast data to determine progress toward institutional goals and objectives.
  • Confers with administration and leadership to review achievements and discuss changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status and conditions.
  • Serves as a member of institutional committees related to assessment, accreditation, and compliance, including, taking a leadership role as appropriate.
  • Manages ALSA staff, including approval of staff time and leave, budget reconciliation, and professional development.
  • Coordinates all mock site visits and all accreditor site visits across institutional and programmatic accreditation activity.
  • Maintains a comprehensive timeline of all accreditation activities across all programs.
  • Compiles and submits reports required by institutional leadership and by state, local, and federal regulatory and accreditation agencies.
  • Acts as liaison between all offices on campus and accrediting, licensing, and state authorization agencies.
  • Participates in professional training, conferences, and conventions relevant to accreditation, licensure, and regulatory compliance.

Institutional Accreditation & Accreditation Liaison Officer (ALO)

  • Serves as the official liaison between the institution and WSCUC, its institutional accreditor.
  • Leads and manages the institution's relationship with WSCUC, including reaffirmation, annual reporting, substantive change, and Substantive Change Committee activity.
  • Serves on WSCUC Peer Review Teams as member and Assistant Chair.
  • Serves on the WSCUC Substantive Change Review Committee.
  • Serves as the key resource in planning the institution's reaffirmation process.
  • Serves as the focal person on campus for the collection and dissemination of information about institutional accreditation, responding to inquiries and making appropriate information available to campus stakeholders.
  • Reviews and approves all self-studies for institutional accreditation prior to submission.
  • Identifies substantive changes that trigger additional state notifications or applications (for example, DC HELC, IBHE, THECB, and BPPE) and coordinates the corresponding filings.
  • Maintains WSCUC accreditation handbooks, guidelines, self-studies, institutional reports, evaluation team reports, schedules of evaluations, and copies of all related correspondence.
  • Organizes follow-up reports requested by WSCUC.
  • Prepares and submits the institution's Annual Report to WSCUC.
  • Notifies WSCUC in advance of planned substantive changes and oversees their submission.
  • Develops and delivers institution wide training on WSCUC standards and criteria.

Programmatic Accreditation

  • Directs a portfolio of more than 30 concurrent programmatic accreditation relationships, spanning accreditors that may include APA, ABAI, CACREP, COCA, COAMFTE, CCAPP, CEPH, CTC, MPCAC, NASP, ACOTE, and ARC-PA.
  • Oversees all phases of the programmatic accreditation lifecycle, including intents, self-studies, applications, annual reports, interim and special reports, substantive changes, and mock and accreditor site visits.
  • Supports the development of all programmatic accreditation and approval applications, including for new program launches.
  • Reviews and approves self-studies and other substantive submissions for institutional and programmatic accreditation prior to submission.
  • Serves as the secondary liaison between the institution and all programmatic accreditation and approval agencies.
  • Serves as the focal point on campus for the collection and dissemination of accreditation related information and responds to inquiries from campus stakeholders.
  • Identifies and details the academic and institutional work needed between site visits to position the institution for future accreditation requirements.
  • Research has been researched into all new proposed accreditors for planning purposes.

State Authorization

  • Oversee the tracking, preparation, and submission of all state authorization applications, renewals, and annual reports across all states in which the institution operates.
  • Tracks state regulatory changes on a monthly basis and communicates relevant developments to institutional leadership.
  • Provides return on investment (ROI) recommendations to leadership when state regulations change, informing decisions on continued state authorization.
  • Oversee the institution's annual state authorization audit.
  • Oversee all new program applications, and exemption applications where applicable, for state authorization purposes.
  • Oversee the institution's participation in the annual state authorization Gap Analysis conducted in collaboration with The System Office.
  • Maintains the institution's membership with the State Authorization Network (SAN).
  • Maintains a tracking document for all state authorization activities.
  • Directs the assignment and oversight of state portfolios among the ALSA team.

Licensure

  • Overseas institutional licensure compliance, including the mid-year and annual licensure audits.
  • Stays current with licensure changes across all states in which the institution operates.
  • Reviews all licensure related disclosures prior to submission.
  • Communicates licensure related regulatory changes to leadership and to academic programs as needed.
  • Serves as the secondary point of contact for state licensing board activity, with programs serving as the first point of contact, and validates all communications and submissions to state licensing boards.
  • Coordinate with Program Chairs, Deans, Administration, and System leadership on licensure related matters.
  • Oversees preparation of student licensure related disclosures and denial communications as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Carries out supervisory responsibilities for ALSA Coordinator staff in accordance with institutional objectives, policies, and applicable employment law, including hiring, performance management, workload assignment, and professional development.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Minimum Education Required

Doctoral degree or professional terminal degree.

Minimum Experience Required

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible academic administrative experience specific to regulatory and compliance areas.
  • Direct experience with institutional (specifically WSCUC) and programmatic accreditation (specifically those listed above) in higher education.
  • Direct experience and knowledge of state authorization requirements, including both NC-SARA and non-NC-SARA (direct, state by state) authorization nuances.
  • Direct experience and knowledge of licensure regulations and state licensing boards.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance processes affecting higher education.
  • Presentation experience.
  • Excellent writing, verbal, research, organizational, and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience serving on an institutional accreditor's peer review teams.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent programmatic accreditation relationships.
  • Experience with direct, state by state authorization processes and the State Authorization Network (SAN).
  • Experience providing written oral reports on assessment plans, strategies, and results.
  • Experience conducting faculty and staff seminars and workshops on accreditation, assessment, evaluation, and related topics.
  • Proficiency with quantitative and qualitative research methods.
  • Higher education teaching experience.

This job description reflects the general nature and scope of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required.

Team Description:

The Ads Retrieval ML team builds the machine learning systems that identify relevant advertising candidates for Reddit users. Retrieval sits at the heart of the ads delivery funnel: before downstream ranking and auction decisions, our models determine which campaigns and ads are eligible to compete. We work on large-scale retrieval across multiple objectives, placements, and geographies. Our work combines representation learning, candidate generation, nearest-neighbor search, behavioral and contextual signals, and rigorous offline and online experimentation.

Role Description:

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Retrieval ML team. You will lead the design and evolution of retrieval models and modeling practices that improve relevance, advertiser outcomes, and user experience at Reddit scale. This is an applied ML role centered on retrieval modeling and end-to-end product impact. You will be expected to stay close to the technical details—from data and objective design through model development, evaluation, experimentation, and launch—while setting direction for other engineers.

Responsibilities:

  • Define the technical direction and multi-year roadmap for ads retrieval modeling in partnership with engineering, product, data science, and ads stakeholders.
  • Design, develop, and launch candidate-generation and retrieval models for campaigns and ads across Reddit’s advertising surfaces.
  • Apply modern approaches such as two-tower architectures, representation learning, embeddings, sequence models, graph-based methods, and other deep learning techniques when they create meaningful product value.
  • Improve the retrieval stack across key modeling decisions, including objectives, labels, sampling strategies, hard-negative mining, feature design, embedding generation, candidate filtering, and retrieval depth.
  • Work with approximate nearest-neighbor and vector retrieval systems, reasoning about recall, relevance, freshness, diversity, coverage, latency, and cost trade-offs.
  • Establish strong evaluation practices that connect retrieval metrics—such as recall, precision, candidate coverage, calibration, and downstream lift—to ads and user outcomes.
  • Lead offline analysis and online experiments, interpret ambiguous results, and translate findings into the next modeling iteration.
  • Partner with downstream ranking, ads platform, auction, measurement, and product teams to ensure retrieval models integrate effectively into the full ads funnel.
  • Write design documents, review code and model changes, and raise the quality bar for modeling, testing, observability, and production ownership.
  • Mentor ML engineers and help grow the team’s expertise in retrieval, recommendation, and representation learning.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of industry experience, including substantial experience building and shipping applied ML products.
  • Deep experience with information retrieval, candidate generation, recommender systems, ranking, or related relevance problems.
  • Strong understanding of retrieval modeling concepts, including DNN, embeddings, two-tower or dual-encoder models, approximate nearest-neighbor search, and multi-stage retrieval.
  • Deep experience training, evaluating, debugging, and deploying deep learning models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ownership of ML projects from problem framing and data preparation through offline evaluation, online experimentation, production launch, and iteration.
  • Strong command of experimental design and model evaluation, including how offline retrieval metrics relate to downstream business and user metrics.
  • Experience working with large-scale behavioral, contextual, or content datasets and complex feature pipelines.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to write clear, reliable, maintainable production code.
  • Technical leadership experience: setting direction, leading complex projects, influencing partner teams, and mentoring other engineers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex modeling choices to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with ads retrieval, ad serving, recommendation, search relevance, or marketplace optimization
  • Experience modeling user, content, campaign, or ad interactions with sequential, graph, or multimodal signals
  • Experience connecting retrieval improvements to downstream ranking, auction, conversion, revenue, or user-experience outcomes
  • Experience in ads marketplaces at peer companies
  • Publications, patents, or industry contributions in applied ML or ranking systems
  • Experience with sequential modeling (e.g., RNNs, Transformers)

It is a fast-growing small company that manages Amazon accounts and runs its own brand, offering eco-friendly products. The team works fully remotely, allowing for flexibility and efficiency while maintaining strong collaboration.

The company operates in an international and rapidly evolving market, providing a dynamic work environment. It encourages creativity and initiative, giving team members the opportunity to bring new ideas to life and make a real impact.

jobs.excerpt: About ToptalToptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand.
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk — and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request isn’t the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isn’t the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

jobs.excerpt: Who You AreYou're a systems thinker who builds, not just administers.
jobs.description:
Who You Are

You're a systems thinker who builds, not just administers. You genuinely love owning Salesforce, and you're just as interested in the ecosystem of tools around it: how data and processes flow between the CRM, lead routing, sales engagement, enrichment, and everything else plugged in.

You're happiest when you're knee-deep in a workflow that didn't exist yesterday, wiring together tools and data to make the GTM team move faster with less friction. You're analytically sharp, technically hands-on, and pragmatic about new technology, focused on what actually ships and what actually moves the number.

You're also detail-oriented and reliable. When something breaks, a flow misfires, an integration stops syncing, a field update doesn't cascade the way it should, you dig in, figure out whether the problem lives in Salesforce or in one of the tools around it, and fix it without needing a committee to weigh in. You understand that changes to a system this many people rely on need to be careful, tested, and reversible.

You build deep partnerships across RevOps, Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and CS, and you enjoy making the people around you more effective and more self-sufficient. If something is broken, you fix it. If something doesn't exist yet, you build it.

Sound like you? You might be our next Business Systems Manager.

About the Role

Own the system of record

  • Own Salesforce end to end: user and license management, configuration, flows, automation rules, custom objects, routing logic, data integrity, and day-to-day upkeep.
  • Serve as the go-to person for how our systems connect: what triggers what, where data originates, and where it breaks when something changes upstream.
  • Implement data governance including source-of-truth decisions, field standards, naming conventions, and change control with RevOps stakeholders.
  • Own enrichment and data hygiene strategies including deduplication, normalization, validation, and automated QA.
  • Build and maintain a data dictionary and reporting best practices so leadership can access insights self-serve.

Own the integration layer

  • Own the health of integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM stack: Apollo, ChiliPiper, Slack, marketing automation, quote-to-cash, call intelligence, and data warehouse connections.
  • Build and maintain integration pipelines so data flows cleanly and systems talk to each other without manual intervention.
  • Monitor data flow between systems and troubleshoot when data stops syncing correctly.
  • Design and implement lead routing, territory assignment, and attribution frameworks that scale as the GTM org grows.
  • Update and maintain core sales processes as the org evolves: new hires, team changes, territory and quota shifts.

Automate and improve

  • Build and maintain automations that scale repetitive processes across the GTM lifecycle, from MQL activation and lead routing to account health scoring and CRM hygiene.
  • Identify GTM bottlenecks and implement workflows that remove manual effort, including intelligent segmentation, auto-summarization, data entry reduction, and QA checks. Use AI where it earns its place.
  • Support initiatives like automated MQL activation, SPICED coaching, and streamlined quoting that reduces dependency on traditional CPQ tools.
  • Prototype quickly, productionize what works, and instrument outcomes so you can measure time saved, lift in conversion, and reduction in data defects.

Partner across the business

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success to translate process requirements into automated, scalable systems.
  • Be the go-to technical resource for the RevOps team, helping non-technical operators get more out of our automation tooling as the team scales.
  • Respond to ad hoc requests from Sales and RevOps to fix, adjust, or extend functionality across Salesforce and connected tools.
  • Collaborate with Product Operations and Engineering when initiatives require product usage data or backend systems.
  • Evaluate new GTM tools pragmatically (build vs. buy), run pilots, define success criteria, and implement with scalability in mind.
  • Partner with Security and IT on privacy, data access boundaries, vendor risk, and responsible use of automation.

What You've Done Before:

  • 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a GTM systems role at a B2B SaaS company, with deep hands-on ownership of Salesforce including flows, automations, and object relationships. Admin certification preferred.
  • A proven history of shipping cross-functional systems projects, not just executing tickets. You create durable patterns that scale.
  • Experience managing and troubleshooting integrations across a modern GTM stack (Apollo, ChiliPiper, or similar routing, engagement, and enrichment tools). You understand how systems are meant to talk to each other, not just how to configure one tool in isolation.
  • Built workflow automations in a platform like Workato, Make, n8n, or equivalent, and connected systems via REST APIs and webhooks.
  • Strong analytical fluency: you can define KPIs, diagnose funnel issues, and maintain the data quality standards that make reporting and forecasting trustworthy. Working knowledge of SQL.
  • A strong understanding of the B2B SaaS GTM lifecycle, from lead generation and MQL activation through pipeline, deal progression, and renewal.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, working independently in a fast-moving remote environment.

It'd be Great if You've Done This

  • Experience supporting a sales org through a lifecycle stage or sales process overhaul.
  • Direct experience with sales engagement, routing, or enrichment tools (e.g., Chili Piper, Apollo, Clay) and how they integrate with a CRM.

Benefits & How We Work

We do not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind—whether committed by managers, peers, clients, or vendors. jobs.description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and are at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 400+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

The Opportunity

We're hiring Licensed Mental Health Therapists (LCSW, LPC, LMHC, LMFT) to provide therapy for autistic and neurodivergent adults via telehealth. You'll join a team dedicated to creating affirming, accessible mental health services for the neurodivergent community.

Our clinicians come from diverse backgrounds and career stages - whether you're passionate about neurodiversity advocacy, seeking flexibility and better work-life balance, or looking to add specialized experience to your existing practice, we offer roles to match your professional goals.

Why Therapists Choose Prosper:

  • Focus on what matters most: Provide exceptional client care while we manage administrative tasks, insurance billing, and client acquisition
  • Enjoy scheduling flexibility: Design your work schedule to accommodate personal needs and maintain optimal work-life balance
  • Scale your practice quickly: Build your caseload with steady client referrals during your first few weeks, with most clinicians reaching their ideal caseload within 4-6 weeks
  • No-show and late cancellation reimbursement: Receive 50% reimbursement for late cancellations and no-shows
  • Grow professionally: Access regular peer consultation, specialized training, and monthly case conferences
  • Neurodiversity-affirming environment: Work alongside clinicians who share your commitment to neurodiversity-affirming approaches
  • Connect with a supportive clinical community: Join weekly drop-ins and engage in a tight-knit clinical community that prevent isolation

We offer two distinct position types to accommodate different career needs and scheduling preferences

Scheduling Availability

  • Set your own schedule, 7 days a week, between 7am and 10pm
  • No required evening, weekend or on-call hours
  • Build your schedule around your life, not the other way around

Full time (Benefits-Eligible)

  • Hours: Provide 25+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 25+ clients
  • Ideal for: Those who seek steady, predictable income that grows with your client base
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session
  • Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package including Medical/Dental/Vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan and PTO.

Part-Time Position

  • Hours: Provide 15+ hours of weekly availability to build a caseload of 15+ clients
  • Ideal For: Practitioners with existing commitments who want to diversify their practice or add specialized neurodiversity experience to your clinical portfolio
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate paid per session

Who We're Looking For

Qualifications:

  • Licensed independent mental health professional (LCSW, LPC, LMHC)
  • Strong clinical skills in evidence-based modalities such as CBT, DBT or ACT
  • Interest in working with autistic or neurodivergent adults
  • Comfort with technology and virtual care platforms (Zoom, EHR, Slack)
  • Excellent communication skills and commitment to client-centered care
  • Telehealth experience preferred but not required

You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You identify with our mission to support the neurodivergent community
  • You're seeking better work-life balance without sacrificing meaningful clinical work
  • You're transitioning from a demanding in-person setting and want more flexibility
  • You want to maintain multiple practice settings and add specialized experience
  • You're passionate about providing affirming care to traditionally underserved populations

Compensation

Our transparent model means your income grows with your client relationships. Unlike traditional salary models, our fee-for-service approach rewards you directly for the sessions you provide. The more sessions you complete, the more your practice thrives – with the security of guaranteed income during no-shows and cancellations.

Join Our Team

Ready to transform lives while advancing your career? Apply today to join Prosper Health's team of dedicated professionals making a real difference for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Prosper Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who identify as neurodivergent, LGBTQ+, or BIPOC.

Competitive W2 rate paid per session. 50% reimbursement for late cancellations/no shows. Paid every 2 weeks for the sessions you provide, no waiting for payment or reimbursement. Benefit Eligible roles available that include Medical/Dental/Vision/401k/PTO

W2 Per Session Rate
$55—$60 USD

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindess, and high-performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients first - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineer Manager role, aligning how we lead teams to best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks.

As our Solutions Consultant Manager, you are the technical leader for your District Solutions Consulting team. You will work closely with the District Sales Manager and, along with your team, build relationships with your customers with the goal of helping them detect and prevent advanced cyberattacks and breaches. Our customers need guidance on what applications to deploy from our platform. Your guidance, expertise, and mentorship of your team will keep them ahead of the latest cyberthreats and stay on the leading edge of prevention.

As the technical leader for your assigned territory, you will guide and develop your team to define innovative technical solutions that secure customers' key business imperatives and maximize the value of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You will champion our industry leadership in on-premises, cloud, and security operations services, establishing Palo Alto Networks as the preferred cybersecurity partner for your customers. You will also nurture talent within your team and provide valuable feedback to the product management team on new feature requests and product improvements based on insights gained from your customer interaction. Your team will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks.

Your Impact

  • Recruit and hire new Solutions Consultants into the territory, hiring the best talent in the industry

  • Responsible for training, mentoring, and reviewing employees on your team, keeping them engaged and successful in their careers

  • Support field Solutions Consultant team in complex evaluations, problem-solving and challenging customer environments

  • Leads and coaches team on successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.

  • Define, create and monitor individual development plans for your team

  • Works closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.

  • Provide effective technical leadership in customer interactions to include sharing security trends and standard methodologies employed by other customers to actively be part of the selling process

  • Drive Palo Alto Networks Platformization efforts within your accounts.

  • Work closely with the Domain Specialist Manager to ensure optimal use of resources and align the required resources to the projects you are handling

  • Act as an escalation point to collaborate with pre-sales and post-sales teams for any issues that arise

  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers to solidify reference accounts and to assist the account teams with defining plans to drive more business

  • Present to customers as our expert in your area at all levels in the customer hierarchy from technician to CIO

  • Discuss competitor products in the marketplace and positions ours as the best alternative

  • Working with Product Management, Technical Marketing, and R&D to build requirements and product features for our large customers and provide feedback from customers

  • 50-75% travel within the region

  • Work with your sales counterpart (DSM) to develop a technical strategy that accelerates growth. Identify key verticals, markets, use cases, and solutions to focus on, and devise a comprehensive strategy and engagement model tailored to your region or district.

Qualifications

  • Experience as a pre-sales System Engineer Manager

  • Experience as a Senior System Engineer/Specialist

  • Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of our roadmap and technology development efforts, knowledge of competitor offerings and products

  • Knowledge of how to deliver comprehensive security solutions to Palo Alto Networks customer base

  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies

  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions

  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills

  • Quota driven attitude focused on client's best solution by being a trusted advisor

  • Proficient in English

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$268,400.00 - $368,975.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

jobs.description:
About us:
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the role:
The Client Success Manager is responsible for supporting a portfolio of Foodsmart’s health plan clients in close partnership with an Account Executive who will support renewal and growth of those accounts. This role is a relationship-driven, execution-focused role centered on delivering exceptional service, driving account retention, and managing issue resolution. You will serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, operating at the day-to-day level, accountable for ensuring program success and long-term partnership value.

You will:

    Account Retention & Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships within relevant client stakeholders while owning day-to-day operational and program leadership relationships across a defined portfolio of accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for operational needs, strategic initiatives, and service delivery while also fostering a culture of continuous improvement
  • Help to drive account retention by maintaining high client satisfaction, proactively addressing service issues, and ensuring consistent program execution
  • Participate in and lead regular client check-ins, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions, providing clear updates on commitments while partnering with the Account Executive to communicate product and service launches/updates
  • Articulate both the qualitative and quantitative value of food and nutrition and the impact of our client partnerships

    • Operations & Service Delivery

  • Execute established account management standards and processes with precision and consistency across your portfolio
    Respond quickly to client-raised issues, triaging and resolving execution-based problems in coordination with internal operations, clinical, product, and support teams
  • Track and manage open action items, deliverables, and timelines to ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Provide customer success and day-to-day support in partnership with Account Executive for complex accounts where dual staffing is needed
  • Maintain accurate account documentation, meeting notes, and activity logs in CRM systems
  • Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, and Clinical Operations teams on implementation needs and ongoing account requirements

    • Program Strategy & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop and execute account strategies that drive success, improvement, and retention, and targeted expansion
  • Lead client-specific program improvements and initiatives, including new program launches and benefit expansions
  • Understand data deeply and use it to drive changes in account strategy; interpret and present ROI and clinical metrics that demonstrate value to clients
  • Prepare and deliver client-facing reporting and materials, including performance updates, program summaries, and business reviews
  • Serve as an internal liaison for client needs, flagging issues and opportunities to the appropriate team members

    • Marketing & Member Engagement

  • Lead delivery of marketing campaigns that drive member enrollment and engagement, ultimately contributing to client satisfaction and retention
  • Work closely with the Foodsmart marketing team to adapt existing materials to client needs and co-create campaigns based on each client's unique situation and member population
  • Leverage marketing data and campaign analytics to refine strategies and report on outcomes to clients

    • Performance Monitoring

  • Monitor key program metrics including member enrollment, utilization, engagement, and clinical outcomes for assigned accounts
  • Identify and address performance gaps or at-risk accounts proactively, escalating to senior leadership as appropriate
  • Support and lead business review preparation and follow-up on resulting action plans

You are:

  • Someone who executes reliably, follows through completely, and thinks strategically about your accounts
  • Responsive and dependable — your clients know they can count on you to respond quickly, resolve issues, and keep programs running smoothly
  • Skilled at building trust at every level of the client organization, from day-to-day managers to executive sponsors
  • Data-driven in how you make decisions and demonstrate value
  • Trusted by senior leaders to manage your portfolio independently while delivering excellent service when partnering with Account Executive on higher-complexity accounts
  • Adept at escalating the right things at the right time while managing to performance targets

You have:

    Required:
  • 2-5+ years of experience in account management, client services, or healthcare consulting, in a client-facing or relationship development capacity
  • Strong organizational skills with a track record of managing multiple accounts or workstreams simultaneously
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust
  • Data-driven mindset with experience analyzing clinical outcomes, marketing data, and campaign performance
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce or equivalent)
    • Preferred:
  • Experience with food-as-medicine programs, nutrition benefits, SDOH interventions, telehealth, wellness, or related health services
  • Familiarity with health plan operations and lines of business (Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid, Commercial)
  • Experience working directly with marketing agencies or internal marketing teams on campaign development
  • Experience in a startup or small company environment
  • Understanding of complex contracting and provider agreements within health plans and health systems
  • Bachelor's degree in business, public health, nutrition, healthcare administration, or a related field

About our benefits and perks:

✅ Remote-First Company

✅ Unlimited PTO

✅ Flexible & remote location

✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
✅ 401k & bonus

✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions

Foodsmart is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our firm policy to extend equal employment and advancement opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth and/or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, disability (physical or mental) and/or a medical condition, genetic information, ancestry, veteran status or service in the uniformed services, and any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a Staff Machine Learning Scientist – Translational AI to provide technical leadership at the intersection of deep learning foundation models, computational biology, and molecular diagnostics. This ownership role drives the architecture and validation of genomic, transcriptomic, and multimodal sequence models to accelerate patient stratification, target identification, and therapeutic monitoring across our cell-free DNA (cfDNA) and multi-omic platforms. This Staff-level position operates with broad technical autonomy, driving modeling strategy across multiple concurrent portfolios while maintaining direct execution responsibilities in model compilation, scaling, and testing. Working within a builder framework, you will align across AI Research, Bioinformatics, and Clinical Science divisions to transition advanced representation learning models into reproducible, clinically valid diagnostic assets.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Scientific Leadership in Translational AI

  • Serve as the principal technical authority on the deployment of molecular, genomic, and pathology foundation models applied to oncology and translational medicine questions
  • Engineer rigorous alignment and post-training workflows that ground pre-trained foundation models in empirical clinical trial and molecular diagnostic data, eliminating speculative modeling assumptions
  • Formulate objective peer-review frameworks and deliver technical feedback to elevate the modeling code, experimental standards, and scientific designs of the broader AI research group

Foundation Models to Biological and Clinical Translation

  • Lead the post-training, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), and evaluation of deep sequence, multimodal, and representation learning models for biomarker discovery, molecular recurrence monitoring, and therapeutic response forecasting
  • Design robust fine-tuning, probing, and latent space representation analysis workflows that extract interpretable, biologically grounded patterns from high-dimensional transformer architectures
  • Validate model outputs against multi-omic benchmarks and real-world outcomes, ensuring model predictions deliver the exact deterministic accuracy required for patient tracking and clinical interventions

Modeling, Experimentation, and Evaluation

  • Build, train, and optimize advanced machine learning models utilizing next-generation sequencing (NGS), ctDNA assays, digital pathology imaging, and longitudinal clinical metadata
  • Design rigorous clinical investigation and evaluation frameworks that connect model performance metrics (e.g., loss curves, precision-recall) directly to translational utility and real-world distribution shifts
  • Systematically identify algorithmic failure modes, sources of dataset bias, and covariate shift, implementing robust mitigation strategies suitable for regulated, clinical-facing pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Influence

  • Partner with Computational Biology, Translational Science, and Medical Affairs teams to translate complex clinical requirements into clear, quantitative machine learning problem statements
  • Act as a systems-level technical bridge between AI Research and ML Engineering teams to ensure that validation models convert seamlessly into scalable, reproducible production workflows
  • Provide technical leadership and data execution support for strategic external collaborations, pharmaceutical partnerships, and foundation model research consortiums

Scientific Communication and External Presence

  • Translate complex multimodal model architectures and performance metrics into transparent, high-integrity data packages for clinical governance, leadership updates, and external collaborators
  • Lead the authoring of technical manuscripts for peer-reviewed machine learning venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and major computational biology journals
  • Act as a technical representative for the company's translational AI capabilities at international medical, oncology, and machine learning conferences

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biomedical Engineering, or a highly quantitative structural field
  • 5+ years of industry or post-doctoral experience applying deep learning frameworks to complex biological, genomic, or clinical datasets, with a documented focus on oncology or immunology portfolios
  • Deep technical competency with transformer architectures, representation learning, self-supervised learning (SSL), or deep sequence modeling
  • Proven track record of translating machine learning outputs into verifiable biological variables or clinical performance indicators, rather than optimizing solely for isolated cross-validation metrics
  • Expert proficiency in PyTorch and modern machine learning infrastructure (e.g., HuggingFace ecosystem, PEFT, Captum, MLflow, and distributed GPU computing setups)
  • Documented technical leadership through end-to-end project ownership, architectural design authority, or cross-functional team direction

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience constructing or fine-tuning multimodal foundation models that combine high-depth genomic sequencing data with digital pathology images or longitudinal electronic health records (EHR)
  • Direct experience handling clinical trial datasets, real-world data (RWD/RWE), or developing models within health-authority/regulatory-facing frameworks
  • Strong record of publications as primary author in high-impact machine learning venues

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Advanced mathematical and algorithmic fluency across deep learning methodologies, optimization strategies, and probabilistic modeling
  • Fast learner with the capability to master complex cfDNA platforms, biochemistry workflows, and multi-omic data generation pipelines rapidly
  • Precise written and verbal communication styles with strict attention to algorithmic detail and statistical validation boundaries
  • Proven capability to drive independent portfolios while executing cross-functional objectives within matrixed technology and scientific teams
  • High-growth builder mindset with the capability to balance scientific rigor, operational execution speed, and computational resource constraints under tight timelines
  • Utilize cloud-based productivity and high-performance computing infrastructure to maintain high operational momentum in a fast-evolving artificial intelligence environment
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.
