MyTime has product-market fit. Our platform is mature, differentiated and proven at enterprise scale, and the business has already scaled into the double-digit millions in revenue — largely on the strength of the product and word of mouth.

We are now making a deliberate investment in a dedicated enterprise sales motion, and hiring the leader who will architect it.

You will be designing that motion, not inheriting one. The playbook, the team, the named-account model, the forecast — all of it is yours to build. You will close anchor enterprise accounts personally, turn how you won them into something repeatable, hire the account executives who run it, and coach them until they can do it without you. In year one, you build and sell. As the team scales, your job shifts from personally proving the motion to building the organization that executes it. In year two, you are running the engine that defines how this company grows.

These are real enterprise deals — multi-location and franchise brands, complex buying committees, and sales cycles measured in quarters and sometimes longer. When you win one, you win dozens or hundreds of locations at once.

What you'll own

  • Personally closing anchor enterprise accounts
  • Building a predictable enterprise pipeline engine — named-account prospecting, executive outreach, inbound conversion, and partner and referral channels
  • Building the playbook — discovery, business case, committee navigation, competitive displacement
  • Standing up the operating system: stage definitions, qualification criteria, pipeline instrumentation, forecasting, named-account planning, quotas and compensation design
  • Hiring, ramping and coaching the account executive team
  • Running a forecast with enough discipline and integrity that the CEO and board can actually plan against it

What success looks like in your first year

  • Closed enterprise logos, with the winning patterns codified into the playbook
  • A sales methodology that is documented, taught, and demonstrably repeatable
  • Qualified pipeline built to a coverage level that supports the following year's plan
  • A forecast that holds up against actuals, consistently
  • Your first account executives hired, ramped and certified against a clear performance bar
  • Evidence that reps other than you can win with the motion you built

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, including 4+ years leading teams — with the willingness to carry a personal number during the build phase
  • A demonstrated record personally closing six-figure enterprise SaaS deals through complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes and extended sales cycles
  • You have built part of a sales function from scratch: first playbook, first hires, first instrumentation
  • You have designed stage definitions, forecast models, named-account plans and compensation plans yourself
  • Product-fluent enough to lead discovery and compelling product demonstrations independently, while knowing when to bring in technical or product expertise
  • You have sold against an entrenched incumbent where migration risk was the objection that killed deals
  • You have sold to, or worked in, multi-location or franchise businesses

Preferred: vertical SaaS for physical-location service businesses — beauty, wellness, fitness, pet care, home services, restaurant, dental, veterinary or automotive. Franchise fluency: advisory councils, master agreements, royalty structures.

Why you'll want this

  • You build it, and it is yours. No inherited playbook, no politics, no one else's system to work around. The sales organization at this company can be the one you designed.
  • Real autonomy. Significant pricing discretion, a direct line to the CEO, and field learnings that carry serious weight in what we build next.
  • A product that wins on its merits. You are selling a mature, mission-critical platform — not a pre-product vision.
  • A company that funds its own growth. Profitable and venture-backed. You will be building with resources behind you rather than against a runway clock.
  • Meaningful equity. A real stake in the business you are helping to build.
  • Room to grow. Build a repeatable enterprise sales engine and demonstrate that you can scale the organization behind it, and there is a natural path toward broader revenue leadership.

Compensation and logistics

Base salary $210,000–$235,000 · Target variable $190,000–$215,000 · On-target earnings $400,000–$450,000 · Meaningful equity · Full healthcare benefits.

Your variable compensation includes a guaranteed, non-recoverable ramp during your first nine months, tapering as you build the enterprise pipeline and transition onto the standard incentive plan.

Fully remote within the United States. Expect roughly 10–20% travel for customer headquarters, executive meetings, trade shows and franchise conferences.

If you have been waiting for the role where you get to build the whole thing — this is it.

  • 10+ years of sales experience, preferably in scaling a metrics-driven SaaS sales team at a rapidly growing technology company in a highly competitive market
  • 3-10 years of sales leadership: hired at least 6 successful, high performing sales reps and managed at least 8 sales reps or managers-of-managers within dynamic sales teams
  • Executed a sales playbook used to acquire customers with $250K+ ACV. Strong preference for experience in designing and implementing the playbook from scratch. MEDDIC preferred
  • Preference for Sales management experience with an organization that has scaled at least to $30+M ARR. Front-office software (i.e. martech, sales-tech, etc.) preferred but will accept any complex software sales except ad sales or hardware
  • Preference for experience selling into Multi-Location or Franchises but any industry works as long as sale was $250 K+ ACV and involved a complex DMU of 3+ people
  • Extensive sales operations experience (forecasting, planning, analysis, sales systems, reporting, compensation and quota management)
  • Ability to build vision, understand and define requirements, design practical solutions, develop supporting business cases and implement solutions for clients
  • Strong experience using CRM and Marketing Automation tools such as Salesforce, Hubspot, etc.
  • Strong problem solving skills, project management, time management
  • High levels of analytical horsepower and ability to turn analysis into insight and actions
  • Very organized with attention to detail
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or related discipline, or equivalent additional experience

This role can be done remotely as long as you're willing to work during standard Eastern Time Zone business hours.

MyTime is a fully remote company. The teams meet virtually throughout the day to collaborate. We provide a competitive base salary, performance bonus, startup equity, and healthcare benefits. We offer a transparent and exciting startup culture that is singularly focused on empowering people to make an impact in their jobs. We’re growing fast and solving a big problem, providing our employees the opportunity to make the tremendous impact that leads to true professional fulfilment. If you're interested, we'd love to talk!

MyTime is the business operating system that multi-location enterprise and franchise brands in pet care, beauty salons, medspas, and barbershops use to run their operations. Scheduling, point of sale, payments, customer engagement, marketing and analytics on a single platform — with AI woven through it to orchestrate each customer's journey and what should happen next.

Our software runs thousands of locations around the world, from independent operators to multi-billion dollar Fortune 500 chains. We are profitable and venture-backed by Upfront Ventures and Stage 2 Capital, and were founded by Ethan Anderson, whose first company, Redbeacon, won TechCrunch50 and was acquired by The Home Depot.

Come help us realize our goal of becoming the world’s leading appointment scheduling and retail commerce platform!

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing Strategy - Owned Assets
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT GREYSTAR Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing.
jobs.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Manager, Marketing Strategy engages with real estate operations leaders, client representatives, and other marketing leaders and teams to create and develop marketing playbooks and the individual property marketing strategies, timelines, and budgets that align with and enable achievement of the property’s brand priorities, financial targets, and goals around operational performance over the life of the property. The position serves as an active participant on the Four-Person Teams responsible for property and/or portfolio performance to track, monitor, and identify emerging trends or potential issues that may adversely impact performance, make recommendations for adjusting marketing strategies or other actions to maximize results or correct and address deficiencies, and proactively implement advertising spend recommendations to increase the return on investment. The Manager, Marketing Strategy is responsible for conducting educational and training sessions for property team members on optimizing the use of marketing tools, products, and systems, and collaborates with marketing team members to promote the sharing of marketing best practices and coordinate on strategic and portfolio-level initiatives.

**Occasional travel within the US will be required.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Engage and partner with real estate operations leaders, marketing leaders and teams, and client representatives to create and develop marketing playbooks and individual property marketing plans, strategies, timelines, and budgets that align with and enable achievement of the property’s brand priorities, financial targets, and goals for operational performance over the life of the property.

  • Serve as the marketing voice on the Four-Person Teams responsible for overseeing and managing the performance of the properties by tracking and monitoring marketing and performance data to identify emerging trends or potential issues and opportunities, and making recommendations for adjusting marketing strategies to maximize results or correct and address performance setbacks and deficiencies.

  • Lead and manage efforts to maximize revenue and return on investments by recommending and implementing strategic and proactive decisions related to advertising spend, ensuring compliance with the property’s approved marketing budget, and closely tracking and managing marketing spend to contain or reduce costs without adversely impacting the revenue impact from marketing strategies.

  • Oversee the development and delivery of educational and training sessions for property team members to promote the optimum use of marketing tools, systems, and products, such as Reputation.com, Modern Message, Social Media, and Entrata Message Center. Seek team member feedback to evaluate their understanding and knowledge of various marketing tools and resources, and provide job aids, user guides, video tutorials, and other materials to support the effective application of marketing products.

  • Monitor and stay up to date on business activities, decisions, and other strategic actions that may impact planned or in-progress marketing plans at assigned properties or portfolios, access, review, and report on marketing metrics, reputation sentiment, and other marketing-related key performance indicators, and appropriately adjust or recommend changes to marketing strategies to adapt to business changes or other factors impacting property performance.

  • Collaborate with and promote ongoing communication with the team members and leaders of the other business groups within the Greystar-Owned Marketing function to share best practices, support, lead, or participate in marketing-related initiatives, projects, and pilots of new products and programs, and promote and elevate the quality of services and support provided by the business group.

  • Act as the marketing strategy leader and owner for portfolio acquisitions and dispositions by adhering to and following acquisitions and dispositions checklists, specific resources and requirements established for Greystar-owned properties, and overseeing the execution of marketing activities that enable the effective and smooth transition for incoming and outgoing properties.

  • Recruit, interview, hire, develop, and manage team members by following and complying with the Company’s human resource policies, processes, and practices, and by demonstrating effective leadership behaviors that align with the Greystar values and philosophies around People and that foster and promote a positive, productive, and engaging work environment.

  • Seek and provide input and feedback to other business groups within the Owned Asset Marketing function to promote teamwork and collaboration and to create and implement changes to processes, practices, standards, and services to improve property marketing results, increase revenue generation, and drive greater efficiency, effectiveness, and operational excellence within the function.

Organizational Responsibilities

  • Maintain a current knowledge of the Company’s marketing function’s infrastructure, marketing products, programs, and strategies currently in place, and the established policies, protocols, standards, and other requirements related to marketing and the Greystar brand. Stay up to date on preferred marketing vendors and suppliers, including external creative agencies, and stay informed about the Company’s long-term and immediate priorities for the Greystar-owned portfolio, including acquisitions and new development.

  • Build, establish, and access a network of experts and professionals inside and outside of the multifamily real estate industry and attend or participate in conferences, professional associations, and other events that contribute to professional growth. Set and communicate standards for team member participation in activities that support their professional growth and development and discipline expertise.

  • Follow and oversee team member compliance with the Company’s established operating, systems, financial, and human resources policies and procedures, and meet Company and departmental standards and requirements related to job performance.

  • Personally practice proper safety techniques, follow the Company’s risk and safety policies and procedures, and immediately report any team member or visitor injuries, accidents, or other safety-related issues to the appropriate individual(s). Ensure team member awareness of and compliance with safety protocols and procedures.

  • Continually identify and act on opportunities for improving the level and quality of service provided by the National Marketing function, and lead efforts that improve the function’s efficiency, effectiveness, productivity, and overall contributions to the Company.

Physical Demands

  • Incumbents must be able to view computer screens, paper documents, reports, and other written materials for extended periods of time where visual strain may result.

  • Occasional travel within the US may be required to attend business meetings, training sessions, conferences, or other situations necessary to accomplish all or parts of the daily responsibilities of this position.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or comparable experience in marketing, communications, advertising, general business, or a related field. 5-7+ years’ experience in a marketing leadership position within a mid-to-large size services type business, or a creative or digital media agency. Experience in real estate property management is preferred for this role, and particularly knowledge of marketing-related product, programs, concepts and practices common to the multifamily housing industry.

  • Very strong process and project management skills and a proven track record in successfully managing teams that execute the completion of multiple activities, tasks, and processes according to specified timelines, legal standards, and defined outcomes.

  • Skilled in organizing and managing personal and team productivity, meeting deadlines, and coping and managing through quickly changing priorities and environments. Demonstrated proficiency in solving problems, thinking strategically and creatively, and resolving conflicts is required.

  • Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, with a strong customer-centric orientation. Solid ability to make creative and compelling presentations related to marketing strategies, marketing budget formulation, and key performance indicators and metrics to diverse audiences, including clients, investors, and other internal and external stakeholders.

  • Must be experienced in interacting with team members from multiple functional disciplines and different job levels, as well as building and maintaining productive relationships with external vendors and suppliers, and business leaders throughout the Company.

  • Excellent leadership and people-management skills, with solid experience in acquiring and developing talent, building and managing teams comprised of diverse team members, and promoting a productive and energized work climate that encourages team member growth, engagement, and retention. Some experience in managing through performance issues and conflicts, and coaching and mentoring line level team members.

  • Skilled and comfortable in using digital and online software and apps to accomplish work, manage and organize time, and communicate, including the ability to use Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and TEAMS, email, and virtual meeting software. Strong skills in advanced Excel functions are preferred, including use of pivot tables.

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $95,000.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage; costs discounted after 3 and 5 years of service.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.


Greystar will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Greystar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process. Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). If you receive suspicious requests, please report them immediately to .

October 16, 2026

This date may be subject to change due to evolving business needs.

jobs.excerpt: Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.
jobs.description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a systems-minded, digitally fluent Senior Designer to build the visual foundations that make Insider One unmistakable and scalable. Working with the Creative Director, Website Development Team, and other designers, you’ll own brand systems and web design from concept to production-ready execution, creating the components, templates, and page experiences that help global marketing move faster without sacrificing quality.

This hands-on senior individual-contributor role is for someone who thinks beyond one-off assets. You’ll translate brand and business goals into responsive websites, landing pages, campaign systems, and reusable frameworks; partner with developers through handoff and QA; and use Claude and MCP-enabled tools to accelerate exploration, prototyping, documentation, and production. You’ll thrive in ambiguity and own the work until it is live.

What You Will Do

    • Partner with the Creative Director to evolve Insider One’s visual identity and turn brand strategy into distinctive, high-performing digital experiences.

    • Build and document scalable brand systems in Figma, including components, variables, grids, templates, iconography, illustration, typography, and image treatments.

    • Own website pages, landing pages, launch experiences, and microsites from information structure and wireframes to responsive, developer-ready design.

    • Work closely with the Website Development Team on interactions, feasibility, accessibility, performance, handoff, and detailed design QA before launch.

    • Design for WordPress confidently, understanding templates, reusable modules, CMS constraints, and responsive behavior; Elementor is a strong advantage.

    • Turn ambiguous briefs and complex B2B technology into clear design directions, prototypes, and visual stories, presenting and defending the rationale.

    • Create reusable templates and self-service systems that help designers and global marketing teams produce consistent, on-brand work at speed.

    • Use Claude, Adobe AI tools, and Model Context Protocol-enabled workflows to research, ideate, prototype, automate repetitive work, and improve developer handoff.

    • Review live implementation and other designers’ work, giving precise feedback that protects the brand, raises craft, and develops the wider team.

    • Manage multiple projects with strong file hygiene, version control, documentation, and prioritization, using performance feedback to improve future work.

What You Will Need

    • 6+ years of experience in brand, visual, digital, or web design within fast-growth B2B SaaS, technology, a design studio, or an agency.

    • A standout portfolio showing sophisticated brand systems, responsive web design, digital campaigns, and clear technology storytelling.

    • Expert Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components, variants, variables, libraries, prototyping, responsive systems, and developer handoff.

    • High professional proficiency across Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.

    • Exceptional visual craft across typography, layout, composition, grids, hierarchy, color, image selection, and digital art direction.

    • Strong systems thinking, with proven experience turning visual identity into reusable components, templates, guidelines, and frameworks.

    • Strong knowledge of web and UX principles, including responsive behavior, accessibility, conversion, performance, interaction, and technical constraints.

    • Working knowledge of WordPress from a designer’s perspective, including CMS constraints and implementation validation; Elementor is a plus.

    • Experience collaborating with developers, preparing clear specifications, resolving implementation questions, and completing meticulous QA.

    • Practical, daily use of AI tools such as Claude and Adobe Firefly for research, concepting, iteration, production, and documentation.

    • Hands-on familiarity with Model Context Protocol workflows connecting Figma to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar environments.

    • Comfort with speed and ambiguity, defining problems, proposing direction, managing feedback, and owning work through delivery.

    • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence explaining decisions and working directly with senior stakeholders.

    • A collaborative, low-ego approach, with the ability to strengthen other designers’ work and contribute across global teams.

Was this role made for you?

    Let’s talk! We’re curious beings and can’t wait to get to know you.

    We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not only welcome but also embrace everyone, regardless of sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

What We Offer

    • Enjoy a monthly meal allowance designed to enhance your daily routine.

    • Access comprehensive private health insurance.

    • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and Neoskola, and CloudGuru.

    • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.

    • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets, where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.

    • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.

    • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.

    • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.

    • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.

    • Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks.

We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.

To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.
Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

Overview

The VP of IT Strategy & Transformation serves as an executive leader aligning business strategy with technology execution across North America. This role defines, operationalizes, and evolves the three-year IT strategy, translating enterprise priorities into actionable, value-driven execution plans.

As a key strategic advisor to the CIO and executive leadership team, this role drives cross-functional alignment, resolves systemic operational challenges, and leverages data-driven insights to maximize technology investment returns across all business units.

The position bridges executive stakeholders, vendor partners, and delivery teams, building a high-performing technology portfolio that enhances agility, supports scalable growth, and delivers measurable business outcomes.

Duties & Responsibilities

jobs.description:
About Crossover Health

Crossover Health is creating the future of health as it should be. A national, team-based medical group with a focus on wellbeing and prevention that extends beyond traditional sick care, the company delivers an entirely new model of healthcare—Primary Health—built on the foundation of trusted relationships, an interdisciplinary care team approach, and outcomes-based payment. Crossover’s Primary Health model integrates primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation and more, and delivers care in surround-sound—in-person, virtually and via asynchronous messaging. Together we are building a community of members that embraces healthcare as a proactive part of their lifestyle.

Job Summary

Job Responsibilities

The Clinical Application & Informatics Specialist plays a key role in supporting and optimizing clinical systems, particularly EHR and related applications. This mid-level role combines informatics strategy with hands-on application support and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll serve as both a systems expert and a clinical operations partner—helping bridge technology with real-world care delivery.

Informatics & Strategic Enablement:

  • Lead clinical informatics initiatives that support the integration and optimization of EHR and other clinical systems.

  • Collaborate with product, IT, and data teams to ensure clinical requirements are reflected in platform design and functionality.

  • Gather and prioritize provider and clinical staff feedback to support system improvements and user experience enhancements.

  • Contribute to interoperability efforts, including the evaluation of data exchange standards, APIs, and vendor integrations.

Application Configuration & Support:

  • Configure and maintain clinical applications (e.g., Athenahealth, Elation) to align with evolving workflows.

  • Provide tier-2 support for application-related issues and escalate to vendors or IT when needed.

  • Participate in software upgrades, testing, and system validation.

  • Assist in managing vendor relationships and ensuring service-level expectations are met.

Training & Adoption:

  • Develop training materials, job aids, and tip sheets to support user onboarding and change management.

  • Deliver training and go-live support to providers, nurses, and operational staff.

  • Document clinical workflows and maintain system configuration records.

Project Coordination:

  • Support project timelines, testing plans, and implementation checklists for system changes or new tool rollouts.

  • Track KPIs and performance metrics related to system usage and provider satisfaction.
    Participate in informatics and operations meetings to align on organizational goals and identify opportunities for improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare, Health Informatics, Nursing, Information Systems, or related field.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in clinical informatics, clinical application support, or health IT.

  • Hands-on experience configuring and supporting EHR systems; experience with Athenahealth is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, APIs).

  • Excellent communication and change management skills, with experience translating clinical needs into technical solutions.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's preferred.

  • Preferred certifications: CPHIMS, PMP, Athena or Epic certifications, or relevant technical training.

jobs.excerpt: • Provide The Center for Food Safety and Applied Nutrition (CFSAN) IT System Lifecycle Development and Management Support Services on behalf of the Food and Drug Association (FDA).
jobs.description:
• Provide The Center for Food Safety and Applied Nutrition (CFSAN) IT System Lifecycle Development and Management Support Services on behalf of the Food and Drug Association (FDA). The FDA is seeking Small Business (SB) sources to determine the availability and capability of small business manufacturers or small businesses capable of IT System Lifecycle Development and Management Support Services.
  • The FDA | CFSAN is in need of project management services. The Single Award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) will be awarded by the FDA contracting manager. The Center for Food Safety and Applied Nutrition (CFSAN) is the branch of the United States Food and Drug Administration that regulates food, dietary supplements, cosmetics, drugs, biologics, medical devices, and radiological products.
  • The scope of this contract is to provide the full range of technical and management services necessary to develop, maintain, and enhance CFSAN systems. The general requirements include providing Custom Computer Programming Services (NAICS 541511) to the FDA and CFSAN; and to maintain, support, and evolve code, scripts, views, triggers, jobs, designs, documentation, reports, and templates.
  • There is also a need to establish an ordering vehicle that develops and maintains existing and future Computer to Plate (CTP) systems, which will process structured and unstructured data. The FDA expects between 2-5 new applications/systems to be added to the BPA per year over the duration of this contract. The ProSidian Engagement Team shall provide training services to CFSAN stakeholders for existing applications, application changes, or newly-developed applications. CFSAN will issue individual Task Orders for the Contractor to provide IT Lifecycle Support for the CFSAN IT portfolio of systems as needed. Representative tasks to be performed.

THE BLANKET PURCHASE AGREEMENT IS DIVIDED INTO THE FOLLOWING (9) TASK AREAS:

  • Task 1: Project Management: Task Order level project management to establish control, management, monitoring and notification mechanisms to ensure the individual task orders stay on track to meet the important milestones and performance measures within the awarded task. | DOCUMENTATION: The Contractor shall use FDA supplied templates which will be provided on each individual Task Order as applicable. If an FDA template does not exist, the Contractor may be tasked with drafting a template for approval by the COR.
  • Task 2: O&M and DME Architecture Support Services: The Contractor shall provide the full range of architecture support services in order to formulate the integrated, end-to-end automated systems that provide enhanced IT capabilities necessary to support CFSAN business and mission processes. The goal is a stable evolutionary progression from an organization’s current state to its envisioned future state by identifying tools and technologies that work together to satisfy the needs or changing business needs of the CFSAN users.
  • Task 3: Development, Modernization, and Major Enhancement: The Contractor shall provide the complete range of system development lifecycle support services necessary to develop and enhance CFSAN IT systems and tools as well as their external interfaces to FDA Enterprise and Center Systems and applications. Tasks may encompass the complete lifecycle of activities required for database, application and tool development including, but not limited to requirements elicitation, analysis and validation; system design; code generation; testing; deployment; and documentation. The Contractor shall also develop, support and evolve designs, customizations and process automation such as interfaces, templates, scripts, workflows, interfaces to permit reviewer access to analytics/tools, and reports. Deliverable products shall be validated and tested to ensure that they meet applicable/specified standards, policy, business requirements.
  • Task 4: Systems Integration and Engineering Services: The Contractor shall support CFSAN with integration services. The Contractor shall focus on the development and deployment of integrated information systems that reflect the introduction of a Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) orientation and, moreover, places an emphasis on the recommended acquisition and re-use of existing components—be they FDA components, HHS components, or components acquired from any other source.
  • Task 5: Data Migration and Management Support: The Contractor shall provide data management support for activities related to the development and execution of data architectures, data policies, practices, and procedures that properly manage the full data lifecycle needs of CFSAN. Task #6 - Operations and Maintenance (O&M) and Support Services
  • Task 6: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) and Support Services: The Contractor shall provide the complete range of operations and maintenance support services necessary to maintain CFSAN IT systems. The Contractor shall be responsible for maintaining the “lights on” availability, reliability, and security of the CFSAN IT portfolio through the full range of O&M services. The Contractor shall maintain, support, and evolve code, scripts, views, triggers, jobs, designs, documentation, reports, and templates. The Contractor shall analyze and report on the impact of infrastructure, software upgrades, capacity, and all changes to the technical environment. These day-to-day operations, maintenance, and help desk support ensures that the systems perform their intended functions.
  • Task 7: System and Data Disposition: The Contractor shall identify, recommend and implement the retirement and consolidation of systems, components, technologies, tools and data when they meet the appropriate disposition stage of the lifecycle as defined in the EPLC.
  • Task 8: Training Support for O&M and DME: The Contractor shall provide training services to CFSAN stakeholders for existing applications, application changes, or newly developed applications. The Contractor shall assess the level of capability of the users and the need for training. The Contractor shall prepare a training plan, the training materials, and arrange and conduct training sessions. The training plan and materials shall be provided to the COR for review and approval prior to training.
  • Task 9: Transition Activities: The Contractor shall provide the transition-in and transition-out of activities to develop, operate, and manage the CFSAN IT portfolio. It is the responsibility of both the incoming Contractor and outgoing Contractor to ensure a smooth transition, with minimal disruption to services and support for users. The purpose of the transition is to transfer expert knowledge, data, and artifacts that are used to support applications from the incumbent Contractor to the successor Contractor efficiently.

*** Enterprise Performance Lifecycle (EPLC) Agile Methodology: The Food and Drug Administration maintains a project management methodology framework that incorporates best government and commercial practices through a consistent and repeatable process, and provides a standard structure for planning, managing and overseeing IT projects over their entire life cycle. The HHS Enterprise Performance Life Cycle (EPLC) framework provides that methodology for HHS OPDIVs including FDA.

TEAM PROSIDIAN PERSONNEL SHALL HAVE EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING:

  • Expertise and experience in designing, developing, implementing, communicating, administering and evaluating human resources programs, with emphasis in compensation and classification in large (i.e., over 4,000 employees) geographically dispersed organizations with a technical, multi-faceted mission of national scope.
  • Demonstrated successful experience in designing and implementing innovative private and public sector compensation and pay for performance programs, and/or expertise in a unionized environment.
  • Experience in job analysis and evaluation, with expertise in making accurate Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) exemption determinations, and demonstrated ability to successfully defend those decisions to employees, management, and/or outside parties.
  • Expertise in state-of-the art compensation, pay for performance, and awards programs, with the ability to tailor such programs to a public-sector regulatory/operational organization.

COMPUTER SECURITY SYSTEMS SPECIALIST – ENGAGEMENT TEAM MEMBER QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Analyzes Government requirements and ensures security compliance in various technical environments. Experience assisting a Government agency obtain an Authorizations to Operate for CFSAN’s systems and applications in the FDA technical environment and familiar with FedRamp requirements for Cloud environment. CENDAS wurde 2021 mit der Vision gegründet, Bauprojekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung zu digitalisieren. Unsere Software verbindet echtes Handwerk mit digitalen Prozessen: Vorbereitung, Abwicklung, Steuerung – alle Phasen des Bauprojekts in einer Anwendung. Heute setzen wir als schnell wachsendes Scale-Up mit unserem internationalen Team aus rund 65 Expert:innen neue Maßstäbe für Effizienz und Innovation in der Bauindustrie.

Bei uns kannst du echten Start-up-Spirit erleben und gleichzeitig von strukturierten Prozessen profitieren. Unser Vertriebsteam bietet dir die Möglichkeit, aktiv an unseren Vertriebs- und Marketingprozessen mitzuwirken. Wenn du in einem flexiblen, innovativen und schnell wachsenden Unternehmen echte Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen deines Pflichtpraktikums steigst du in die operative CRM-Arbeit eines wachsenden B2B-SaaS-Unternehmens ein und lernst, wie Kunden- und Vertriebsprozesse datenbasiert gesteuert werden.

Konkret übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

  • Reporting und Dashboards: Du baust bestehende Reports und Dashboards aus, pflegst sie eigenständig und wertest wiederkehrende Kennzahlen für unsere Vertriebs- und Kundenteams aus. Dieser Bereich ist für CENDAS besonders wichtig, da er die Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen bildet.
  • Workflows und Automatisierung: Du konzipierst, baust und testest Workflows und Listenlogiken in unserem CRM-System und hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Abläufe zu automatisieren.
  • Produktdaten und Nutzungsindex: Du unterstützt bei der Aufbereitung und Plausibilitätsprüfung unserer Produktnutzungsdaten, die in unseren Nutzungsindex einfließen.
  • Kommunikation: Du erstellst Entwürfe für E-Mail- und In-App-Kommunikation, setzt A/B-Tests auf und wertest die Ergebnisse aus.
  • Verlässliche Datenbasis: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Daten im CRM-System korrekt und belastbar sind, sodass Sales, CSM und KAM jederzeit auf verlässliche Informationen zugreifen können.
  • Eigenes Projekt: In der zweiten Hälfte deines Praktikums übernimmst du ein abgrenzbares Thema mit sichtbarem Ergebnis – zum Beispiel einen Lifecycle-Report, eine Datenqualitäts-Scorecard oder einen Onboarding-Automatismus.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Du stehst kurz vor dem Studienabschluss – idealerweise in BWL, Marketing, Vertrieb oder Kommunikations- & Medienwissenschaften.
  • Du brauchst ein Pflichtpraktikum – und willst in der Zeit wirklich etwas bewegen, nicht nur Meetings protokollieren.
  • Strukturiert und systematisch zu arbeiten ist für dich kein Zwang, sondern dein natürlicher Modus.
  • Deutsch beherrschst du sicher in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern packst Dinge eigenständig an.
  • Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern aktiv an unseren CRM-Prozessen und Wachstumssystemen mitwirken – in einem Team, das Tempo mag.

Praktikumsdauer: Die Dauer des Praktikums richtet sich nach den Vorgaben deiner Universität.

Benefits

Unser Angebot:

  • Remote-First: Arbeite, von wo du willst – zuhause, unterwegs oder in unserem Coworking Space in Bochum.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Feste Kernzeiten fürs Team, den Rest gestaltest du so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt.
  • Start-up-Feeling: Du bist von Tag eins an mittendrin statt nur dabei – deine Meinung zählt wirklich.
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding: Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser – wir bringen dir das nötige Know-how gezielt bei, damit du schnell loslegst.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CRM-Verantwortlichen und bekommst Einblicke, die du im Studium so nicht bekommst.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin und die geplante Dauer deines Praktikums – am einfachsten über das Formular.

Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schreib uns stattdessen zwei, drei Sätze: Was interessiert dich an CRM, und welches Tool hast du dir schon mal selbst beigebracht?

Weil es sich um ein Pflichtpraktikum handelt, brauchen wir außerdem den Auszug aus deiner Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung, in dem das Praktikum und seine Dauer vorgeschrieben sind. Den kannst du nachreichen.

Du hörst innerhalb von fünf Werktagen von uns.
Fragen vorher? Melde dich direkt bei Robert, Marketing Manager bei CENDAS.

jobs.title: Budget Execution Analyst (supporting NOAA)
jobs.excerpt: ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense.
jobs.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™

ASRC Federal Advanced Research (AFAR), a subsidiary of ASRC Federal Holding Company, is currently recruiting for a remote Budget Execution Analyst to support a federal government client located in Silver Spring, MD.

Key Role:

The successful candidate will provide budget planning and budget execution support for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)/National Ocean Service (NOS) client. The candidate will assist in creating and maintaining the spreadsheets, tools, forms, templates, and instructions to support various monthly and quarterly reports and meetings. Work with various branches to ensure that the new and existing financial processes are understood and implemented correctly. Integral to the role is the ability to analyze data to understand trends, forecast potential budget issues, and to plan and take corrective actions. Track NOS grants as they move through planning, funding, and execution. Provide analyses, assessments, and recommendations relating to financial management activities, among other duties as assigned.

This is a remote position. The duties for this role include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide budget execution support to a NOS Financial Management Center (FMC) or Headquarters.
  • Become adept at pulling reports from the NOAA financial systems, including the Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), and the Financial Management Data System (FMDS)
  • Summarize quantitative data for monthly commitment, obligation, and contract status reports as well as a variety of complex payment reports
  • Assist with creating and monitoring monthly and annual obligation plans.
  • Track funds transferred in from other NOAA or NOS Financial Management Centers
  • Understand the various types of accounting codes (i.e., program, project, and tasks codes) being used and the business rules that govern them.
  • Process documentation for financial corrections.
  • Conduct variance analysis by comparing planned obligations to actual obligations; justify the reason behind variances to FMC leadership and NOAA headquarters.
  • Create and utilize tracking tools to monitor NOS grants as they move through planning, clearance, funding, and execution.
  • Transform accounting system data into Excel spreadsheets and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Produce, maintain, and update templates, forms, process documents, and slides for NOS reviews.
  • Respond to data calls from other FMCs, NOS or NWS Headquarters, NOAA Headquarters, the Department of Commerce, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and/or Congress.
  • Enter data, as requested, into the Financial Management Data System.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree plus 5 years' experience in federal budgeting or related industries (e.g., finance, budgeting, accounting or other highly quantitative field). Four years of relevant experience may be used as a substitute for a Bachelor's Degree. A Master’s Degree may be used as a substitute for 2 years of experience. A PhD may be used as a substitute for 4 years of experience.
  • Ability to transform data and findings into concise, user-friendly spreadsheets and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Excellent oral presentation skills with the ability to brief findings and materials to management.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in groups of senior leaders, knowing when to speak up versus deferring to management.
  • Work proactively to anticipate management’s questions and meet their needs before being asked
  • Sift through large amounts of data and reports to find answers to management’s questions in a timely manner
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including customer service skills, to properly manage customer expectations and respond to customer requests
  • Knowing when to ask for help to be able to meet assigned deadlines

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with the NOAA accounting system is a plus.
  • Experience with government financial systems and terminology is preferred.
  • Passion for the NOAA mission is a plus.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. jobs.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ: DXCM) ist ein Pionier und weltweit führend im Bereich der kontinuierlichen Glukoseüberwachung (CGM). Dexcom begann als kleines Unternehmen mit einem großen Traum: Die Art und Weise, wie Diabetes behandelt wird, für immer zu verändern. Informationen und Erkenntnisse zugänglich zu machen, die zu besseren gesundheitlichen Ergebnissen führen. Heute, 25 Jahre später, haben wir eine ganze Branche geprägt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Wir erweitern unsere Vision über Diabetes hinaus, um Menschen zu befähigen, ihre Gesundheit selbst in die Hand zu nehmen. Das bedeutet: personalisierte, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse, die darauf abzielen, wichtige gesundheitliche Herausforderungen zu lösen. Unser Ziel bleibt: Die menschliche Gesundheit zu verbessern.


Angetrieben werden wir von Tausenden ehrgeiziger, leidenschaftlicher Menschen weltweit, die wie Kämpfer darum ringen, das Vertrauen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu gewinnen – durch Zuhören, Integrität, große Visionen und Verlässlichkeit. Wir haben bereits Millionen Leben verändert – und sind bereit, Millionen weitere zu verändern.

Unsere Zukunftsvision ist es, ein führendes Unternehmen im Bereich der Gesundheitstechnologie für Verbraucher zu werden, während wir weiterhin Lösungen für ernsthafte Gesundheitsprobleme entwickeln. Wir werden dieses Ziel erreichen, indem wir kontinuierlich einzigartige Erfahrungen mit Biosensor-Technologie neu erfinden. Auch wenn wir weit von unseren Anfängen als kleines Unternehmen entfernt sind – unsere Träume sind größer denn je. Die Chance, die Gesundheit weltweit zu verbessern, liegt vor uns.


Senior Market Access Manager CEE – Healthcare

Meet the team:

Are you passionate about shaping the future of healthcare? At Dexcom, our Market Access team is focused on expanding our impact and driving growth.

We’re seeking a collaborative and results-oriented Senior Market Access Manager for Eastern Europe Region (“the Region”) to lead innovative strategies that align with our core values and ambitious growth objectives.

This role can be based remotely in Austria or Slovenia. Relocation support may be available, where legally applicable, for candidates who already have the right to work within the EU and who wish to relocate to a country where Dexcom has an established office. Cross border commuting is not available for this role.

To be successful in this role, you will be fluent in English and a preference for one or more languages among Polish, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian or Turkish. You will also bring strong knowledge and experience of the Market Access landscape across Eastern Europe

Imagine a workplace where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your efforts directly contribute to our success. We believe in fostering a culture where everyone feels empowered, inspired, and excited to come to work each day. If you're looking for a role that offers more than just a job, where you can truly make a difference and have fun while doing it, then we can't wait to meet you! Join us and be a part of something extraordinary.

Where you come in:

  • Work in full collaboration with local partners/distributors to expand access to our therapies in the countries of Eastern Europe Region

Introduction to the Team & Role

What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.

  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.

  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

  • You drive strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
  • Run vendor evaluations end to end
  • Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).

Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

  • IT Certification (A+, MCITP Windows OS, Network +, etc.)

  • Must have a distraction free home office workspace
  • Must be willing to participate in video virtual meetings (camera on)

Compensation and Benefits:

The compensation range for this role has been established at $24.00 - $27.00 hourly. The final agreed-upon compensation is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, skills, prior work experience, competencies, and geographic work location. The above compensation range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Senior Automation Engineer - United States | Remote

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Automation QA Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of web-based applications through robust automation testing, API validation, and database testing. You will collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, product teams, and QA team members to deliver high-quality solutions with confidence and speed.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts using Selenium WebDriver.
  • Create, execute, and optimize automated test cases for web-based applications.
  • Develop and maintain regression, smoke, and end-to-end automation test suites.
  • Perform API testing using tools and frameworks such as Postman, Rest Assured, Swagger, or similar solutions.
  • Validate backend integrations through database testing and SQL query execution.
  • Verify data integrity, backend data flows, and ETL processes across relational databases.
  • Analyze requirements, user stories, and technical specifications to create effective test strategies.
  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, QA team members, and product teams to identify, reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve defects.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous quality validation.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Follow testing best practices, quality standards, and defined quality metrics.
  • Prepare and share test execution reports, defect metrics, and quality dashboards.
  • Support production validation and release testing activities as needed.
  • Contribute to improved automated test coverage, reduced regression effort, earlier defect detection, and stronger release confidence.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in automation testing, quality engineering, or a related software testing role.
  • Strong experience with Selenium WebDriver and automation testing.
  • Experience developing automation frameworks using Java.
  • Knowledge of TestNG and/or JUnit frameworks.
  • Experience with Page Object Model, POM, and automation design patterns.
  • Experience using Maven and/or Gradle build tools.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs.
  • Experience validating API requests, responses, authentication, and error handling.
  • Experience with API automation frameworks and tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, Swagger, or similar.
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to create complex queries for data validation and integrity checks.
  • Experience validating data across relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
  • Experience with JIRA and test management tools such as Testmo, TestRail, or Azure Test Plans.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a distributed team.
  • Strong attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Relevant certifications in Automation Testing, Selenium, or Agile are preferred.
  • Experience working in retail, eCommerce, healthcare, or enterprise applications is preferred.
  • Knowledge of performance testing tools such as JMeter is preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS is preferred.
  • Understanding of BDD frameworks such as Cucumber is preferred.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted testing solutions is a plus.

The base salary range for this position is $92,250 - $120,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays.

jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

The Marketing Operations Manager is the technical engine of the marketing operations function, owning day-to-day configuration and administration of HubSpot, building and maintaining always-on workflows, managing API connections across the martech stack, and helping the marketing team put AI tools, including Claude, to practical, everyday use.

NetBrain's marketing team is building a more sophisticated GTM motion with an emphasis on automation and AI, and that motion depends on reliable systems and clean data. This role closes the gap between strategy and execution: when a workflow breaks, an integration needs to be built, or there's an opportunity to automate manual work, the Marketing Operations Manager gets in the weeds, builds the solution, and brings their own ideas back to the team.

What You'll Do

HubSpot Administration & Configuration.

Serve as the primary HubSpot administrator, owning configuration of properties, pipelines, forms, lists, workflows, and user permissions. Build, test, and maintain always-on workflows that support lead nurturing, lifecycle stage progression, and internal routing, designed to run reliably without manual oversight. Own data hygiene — deduplicating records, enforcing field standards, and keeping contact and company data accurate — and provide technical support for campaign execution (landing pages, emails, forms, lists, reporting) so the marketing team is never blocked on configuration.

Integrations & API Management.

Build and maintain API connections between HubSpot and the rest of the martech stack, including Salesforce, intent platforms, attribution tools, and enrichment vendors. Troubleshoot broken connections, resolve data inconsistencies at the source, document integration logic, and work directly with technology vendors on implementation and troubleshooting.

AI Tooling & Automation.

Help the marketing team put Claude and other AI tools to practical, repeatable use — identifying where automation reduces manual work, drafting workflow logic, and building processes around AI-assisted tasks. Proactively identify manual processes that can be automated, build the replacement workflows, document what was built and why, and test new tools and configurations before rolling them out to the team.

Reporting & Data Support.

Build and maintain HubSpot reports and dashboards that give the marketing team visibility into campaign performance, lead flow, and pipeline contribution. Handle ad hoc reporting and data requests from marketing and leadership, and document configurations and workflow designs so the systems this role builds are understandable to anyone picking them up for the first time.

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of marketing operations experience in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
  • Hands-on HubSpot administration experience is required — proficiency in another marketing automation platform is not a substitute. Comfortable with workflow logic, property configuration, list segmentation, pipeline management, and the HubSpot data model. HubSpot certifications are a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and troubleshoot API integrations between marketing systems, with an understanding of how data moves between platforms and what breaks when it doesn't.
  • Hands-on experience with Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable AI tools in a professional context; ready to help the marketing team adopt Claude effectively from day one.
  • Comfortable reading and working with Salesforce data as it relates to marketing operations — understands how to pull reporting without needing to be a Salesforce administrator.
  • Strong data fluency: able to build a report, read a dataset, and identify what's wrong with it.
  • Precise and detail-oriented, catching problems in workflow logic, field mapping, and API configuration before they propagate.
  • Clear, responsive communicator who can explain what's being built, flag blockers early, and move technical work toward resolution.
  • Curious and adaptable — stays current with martech and AI tooling and brings practical recommendations back to the team.
  • Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
  • Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.

What We Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.

For this role, the estimated base is $130,000 - $150,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.

jobs.excerpt: Business Development RepresentativeCompany: VIN IQ (Media Management Technologies) Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer Location: Remote (Eastern Time business hours) Employment type: Full-time Compensation: $55,000–$65,000 base salary; on-target earnings of $75,000–$85,000 About VIN IQVIN IQ provides VIN-level inventory advertising for automotive dealerships.
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative

Company: VIN IQ (Media Management Technologies) Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer Location: Remote (Eastern Time business hours) Employment type: Full-time Compensation: $55,000–$65,000 base salary; on-target earnings of $75,000–$85,000

About VIN IQ

VIN IQ provides VIN-level inventory advertising for automotive dealerships. Each vehicle on a dealer's lot is marketed individually across Google and Facebook, tied to live inventory data, rather than through broad campaigns at the make or model level. The company sells directly to dealerships and through agency partners, and is currently expanding its outbound sales organization.

This is a small, fast-moving team. The work of every team member is visible from the first week.

Position summary

The Business Development Representative is responsible for generating qualified appointments for the sales team through outbound prospecting. The role is dedicated to appointment setting; it does not include demonstrations, presentations, or contract negotiation.

The Business Development Representative contacts dealership decision-makers — dealer principals, general managers, general sales managers, and marketing directors — and schedules them into a 15-minute discovery call with a VIN IQ sales representative. The offer presented is a complimentary analysis of the dealership's own inventory and advertising performance. The objective of the call is to secure fifteen minutes of the prospect's time and permission to review their data, not to sell a subscription by phone.

VIN IQ runs a two-meeting sales process. The discovery call establishes fit and secures the data access required to build the analysis, and a second meeting is scheduled before the first call ends. In that second meeting, a sales representative presents the completed analysis and closes the business. The Business Development Representative remains responsible for the prospect through both meetings, and is measured on whether the dealership attends the closing presentation.

Responsibilities

  • Complete 80–100 outbound calls per business day, supplemented by email and LinkedIn follow-up
  • Schedule five qualified appointments per week
  • Log all calls, emails, and outcomes in HubSpot the same business day
  • Confirm and re-confirm scheduled appointments to protect show rates
  • Research accounts prior to outreach, including ownership structure, current advertising vendors, and rooftop count
  • Qualify each prospect before booking: correct decision-maker, sufficient inventory volume, and willingness to provide website access for the analysis
  • Report objections and effective messaging back to the sales team to support ongoing script refinement

Performance expectations

First 30 days. Complete onboarding on the product, the market, and the call script. Reach full dial volume by the end of week two and begin setting appointments.

Days 30–90. Sustain five appointments set per week, producing approximately 13 held appointments per month. Maintain CRM records at a standard sufficient for accurate forecasting.

Beyond 90 days. A path to a closing role is available. Representatives who demonstrate consistent appointment-setting performance may earn the opportunity to present and close their own accounts, transitioning from held-appointment compensation to a full commission plan.

Compensation and on-target earnings

Base salary

$55,000–$65,000, based on experience

Held appointment bonus

$65 per appointment held ($25 for Prequalified Meeting Held and $40 for Qualified Meeting Held)

New account bonus

$200 per account closed from a BDR-sourced appointment

Variable at plan

Approximately $19,500 annually

On-target earnings

$75,000–$85,000

Variable compensation is uncapped. At-plan figures assume 13 held appointments per month and a 33 percent close rate on held appointments. Bonuses are paid monthly, based on activity recorded in HubSpot.

Qualifications

  • One to three years of experience in a phone-based sales or customer-facing role; outbound cold calling experience preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to sustain high call volume in a role where rejection is routine
  • Experience maintaining accurate CRM records without supervision
  • Strong verbal communication skills, including the ability to hold a productive conversation with a senior dealership manager
  • Receptiveness to coaching and willingness to adopt revised messaging quickly
  • Automotive retail experience is advantageous but not required

What VIN IQ provides

  • HubSpot with dialer, sequences, and call recording
  • A contact database and a call script validated on live calls
  • Weekly coaching from the Chief Revenue Officer, including call review
  • An established product with active customers and documented results

Performance measurement

Activity not recorded in HubSpot is not counted toward performance expectations. VIN IQ tracks dials, connects, appointments set, and appointments held. Held appointments are the primary measure of performance and the basis for variable compensation.

VIN IQ is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: On-target earnings$75,000–$85,000
