jobs.description:
You’ve Never Been Satisfied with "Good Enough."

You want to make an impact, not just manage projects, but change how the world gets built. At Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects, you’ll do exactly that. You’ll help develop and deliver the factories, grids, transit systems, and public infrastructure that keep communities moving - and do it smarter, safer, and more sustainably than ever before.
You’ll work alongside people who think big and act bold - project managers, engineers, technologists, and strategists who blend real-world experience with digital innovation and AI. Together, we’re transforming how capital projects are planned, managed, and executed, creating a better way to build for the future.
Because “good enough” builds the past. You’re here to build what’s next, on a team that outperforms every norm.
Visit us here to learn more about ​Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects
As Accenture continues to grow, you may see a variety of new career opportunities, and depending on the role and location you may be directed to apply through Accenture Infrastructure and Capital Projects LLP or one of our other legal entities - Accenture Infrastructure and Capital Projects, LLC or Accenture Infrastructure and Capital Projects Inc., with benefits varying by country and role, so please check with your recruiter for details.

THE WORK:

    • You'll serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, building strong client relationships and providing strategic guidance to solve complex project and business challenges.
    • You'll support business development efforts through industry expertise, thought leadership, proposal development, and participation in industry events.
    • You'll act as an Owner's Representative, overseeing capital projects from planning and initiation through execution, closeout, and handover.
    • You'll lead project planning and delivery activities, ensuring alignment with client objectives, budgets, schedules, and performance expectations.
    • You'll coordinate the overall project controls program across risk, schedule, cost, change management, governance, and reporting functions.
    • You'll drive program plans, priorities, deliverables, and action closure to support successful project outcomes.
    • You'll coordinate inputs across project controls functions, project teams, and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and consistency.
    • You'll monitor schedule, cost, risk, and change performance, proactively identifying trends and recommending corrective actions.
    • You'll identify delivery gaps, dependencies, and emerging issues while driving mitigation and resolution strategies.
    • You'll prepare governance materials, executive-level reporting, and performance updates for client and leadership review.
    • You'll escalate blockers, facilitate decision-making, and drive accountable resolution of project challenges.
    • You'll develop and implement program tools, processes, and initiatives that drive operational excellence, team growth, and client success.
    • You'll build and maintain impactful relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including presenting recommendations and updates to executive leadership.
    • You'll monitor program performance, assess client needs, analyze key metrics, and recommend scalable solutions that improve efficiency and outcomes.
    • You'll advise clients on resource planning and allocation strategies, including staffing and Owner Furnished Equipment (OFE) management.
    • You'll collaborate with architects, engineers, contractors, and client teams to drive successful project execution and achievement of program goals.
    • You'll identify and mitigate project risks while fostering effective communication and coordination across project teams, vendors, subcontractors, and stakeholders.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

    • Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Project Management, Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent experience/degree.
    • 10+ years of experience in the data center industry with strong knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) disciplines.
    • 15+ years of progressive experience in construction, capital projects, project controls, or program management.
    • Demonstrated functional knowledge of all phases of construction and capital project delivery.
    • Practical experience across project controls disciplines, including cost management, scheduling, risk management, change management, governance, and reporting.
    • Experience coordinating cross-functional project teams and stakeholders in complex capital delivery environments.
    • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills.
    • Experience preparing executive-level presentations, governance materials, and program performance reporting.
    • Ability to identify project risks, dependencies, and delivery issues and drive resolution independently.
    • Experience in project and program delivery within a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills and excellent computer skills.
    • Proficiency in reading and interpreting contract documents, plans, and specifications.
    • Proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite, Power BI, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or other capital project management and reporting platforms.
    • Experience establishing or improving project controls frameworks, governance processes, and performance reporting mechanisms.
    • Experience supporting large-scale data center, mission-critical, or complex infrastructure programs.
    • Demonstrated ability to operate independently while influencing diverse stakeholder groups across multiple project functions.

Limited travel to area meetings and events, including some evening and weekend work.

No specific physical requirements.

jobs.title: Content Writer (Freelance)
jobs.excerpt: Grizzle is a content marketing agency that helps enterprise B2B and SaaS companies create and distribute authoritative, actionable, and value-driven content.
jobs.description:
Grizzle is a content marketing agency that helps enterprise B2B and SaaS companies create and distribute authoritative, actionable, and value-driven content. Our clients include Semrush, Pipedrive, Tide, CXL, and Web.com, to name a few. Our goal is to help them surpass their revenue, traffic, and brand awareness goals using a proven content marketing methodology.

About the job

We’re looking for talented content writers to work with us on an ongoing basis. We’ll provide you with a steady stream of interesting work, processes, courses to empower you to write articles you’re proud of, and ongoing support from our team of editors.

You’ll be given ample amounts of constructive feedback and dedication from our editors to help you become a stronger writer. This is one of the most cited reasons that writers have worked with us for years:

“As a writer, you want to work with people that get it. Grizzle gets it. They get the importance of good writing. They get that writers need a solid brief, space and time to work, and valuable (constructive, not negative) feedback. And that’s exactly what they deliver. More than that though, they look for ways to get better at helping writers thrive by—get this—talking to them. The regular check-ins are a wonderful thing. Being part of the Grizzle team is a wonderful thing. I’m a better writer for it.”

Clients have worked with us for years because we embed ourselves into their systems and adapt to their brand voice. Therefore, this role is best suited for writers who are comfortable with writing in different styles in-line with documented content guidelines.

Bonus points if you have subject matter expertise in marketing, sales, business finance, HR, or other business topic. We encourage you to check the FAQ at the bottom of this page.

Benefits of working with us

Over the last 7 years, we’ve created effective content marketing playbooks that help our clients surpass their growth goals. Our content performs well in highly competitive markets, and we’re dedicated to helping our clients meet their acquisition, sales, and revenue targets.

However, we’re not a content farm. We take the time to create high-quality content that’s full of unique insights and value-adds. We don’t replicate what’s already out there. Every piece of content must have a purpose. We haven't done our job properly if an audience doesn’t feel empowered by what they read.

If our mission aligns with your values, here are a few other benefits of joining our team:

  • Long-term and reliable freelance retainer

  • Learn about content marketing, SEO, and digital PR

  • Work on industry-leading and interesting SaaS accounts

  • Collaborate with talented content marketers and editors

  • Improve your own marketing skills

  • Access to our internal content and marketing courses

What you’ll be doing

You’ll create authoritative, long-form content that empowers and educates audiences while helping our clients meet their goals and make their lives easier.

Once hired, you’ll collaborate with our senior editors on briefs and drafts. You’ll be given the information and resources you need to create detailed angles and outlines for your content and ensure we go above and beyond competing articles.

From there, you’ll research and write long-form content that's full of detailed examples, actionable insights, and paragraphs that drive points home while closing loops and maintaining logical flow.

More specifically, you will:

  • Research topics and uncover pain points to produce angles and analyze the competitive landscape

  • Create outlines to communicate the logical flow of your narrative and help us collaborate with clients (this significantly reduces feedback during the draft stage and means fewer revisions for you)

  • Write engaging, practical, and informative content that educates, motivates, and inspires readers to take action

  • Share and break down examples and supporting imagery (screenshots, graphs, etc.)

  • Cite relevant and original sources when necessary

  • Follow client guidelines to match their brand voice, tone, structure, and preferences

  • Collaborate with the Grizzle team on each project via ClickUp

Content formats you’ll be writing

  • Blog Articles: Long-form content to drive traffic, educate readers, and convert them into leads, users, and customers.

  • Content Refreshing: Breathing new life into existing content with new sections, examples, and value takeaways.

  • Landing Pages: Product pages for SEO and other channels.

  • Email Content: Newsletters and campaigns.

  • Ebooks: Long-form guides that overdeliver on value.

We’re looking for content writers who:

  • Love creating actionable, in-depth content on a range of B2B topics

  • Strive to create the best piece of content available on a topic

  • Can easily adapt to different writing styles

  • Have acquired subject matter expertise in marketing, sales, finance, HR, or other business topics

  • Are hungry to become stronger writers and work with editors that will help them do so

  • Can write in a clear, concise manner

  • Understand on-page SEO and what makes content valuable

  • Are extremely well organized and can work to deadlines

  • Can communicate in a consistent and reliable manner

You’ll work closely with and learn from a sophisticated content marketing methodology. If you want to improve your marketing skills, you’ll see how we create great content and rub shoulders with some known names in the industry.

We pay our freelance writers per project. You can find info on our project rates here. This can increase after several months of working with us and for larger projects (such as ebooks).

FAQs

What's the typical word count for each project?

Word count can range anywhere from 1,000 to 4,000 words, depending on the specificity and complexity of each topic.

What sort of clients do you work with?

We work with B2B and SaaS brands. Industries range from sales and marketing to fintech and remote working. Check out the logos on our home page.

What's the process to get started?

We always start with a paid test task with multiple phases, followed by a client project.

What content formats do you create?

80% of our projects are blog articles. The rest is made up of landing page copy, ebooks, guest posts, etc.

What are your content workflows?

We have organized processes that are mapped out in ClickUp. You’ll receive a brief, then work with our editors to create an angle, outline, and write a value-driven draft. One round of revisions is baked into the process. Our content marketing editors (CMEs) and copyeditors are there to support you, polish content to perfection, and address client feedback.

Will the content be ghostwritten?

95% of our content is ghostwritten for clients. There’s the odd occasion where we can attribute a byline to our writers.

What project management software do you use?

We use ClickUp for project comms (and provide training on how to use it) and expect writers to keep open lines of communication with us there.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role:Devoted Medical, the affiliated multi-disciplinary virtual care partner of Devoted Health, is dedicated to delivering exceptional healthcare by treating every member with the compassion of family.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

Devoted Medical, the affiliated multi-disciplinary virtual care partner of Devoted Health, is dedicated to delivering exceptional healthcare by treating every member with the compassion of family. We are seeking a Physician, Transitions of Care to provide exceptional patient care to recently discharged patients and advance our innovative clinical model focused on preventing hospital readmissions.

This position represents an exceptional opportunity for an enthusiastic physician leader to drive clinical excellence of Devoted Medical's Transitions of Care (TOC) Program. This is an ideal role for an experienced Hospitalist, Post-Acute Physician, Virtual Care Physician, or Value-Based Primary Care Physician with a background in Geriatrics, Palliative Care, or Complex Care Management looking to lead virtual care delivery and readmission reduction strategies.

The TOC program provides virtual care in the 30-day window after a patient is discharged from the acute setting (hospital or skilled nursing facility), serving patients across multiple states with the goal of preventing readmissions through exceptional, comprehensive wrap-around care. The program leverages cutting-edge technology and artificial intelligence (AI) to provide the best care possible.

The Physician will deliver high-quality clinical care to patients at high risk for readmission as part of a collaborative interprofessional team (IDT) of healthcare professionals, including nurse practitioners, physicians assistants, registered nurses, medical assistants, and clinical coordinators. This role combines direct patient care (approximately 70% of time) with team development, coaching for clinical excellence within an IDT, leading clinical problem-solving, and facilitating rounds (approximately 30% of time focused on clinical supervision, escalations, and clinical model improvement). Leadership in this role is focused on clinical supervision rather than direct administrative management.

You will be supported by advanced AI-enabled technology and comprehensive Devoted Medical programs — including virtual urgent care, specialty care such as palliative care, complex care management, and clinical pharmacy services. Because Devoted is a tech-forward, fast-moving organization, physicians are expected to support the training and application of AI tools that enable an unprecedented quality of care for our patients. This position offers the opportunity to impact patient outcomes at scale in a modern, tech-supported care environment.

This role is designed for a physician with an entrepreneurial mindset who can leverage their deep clinical background to spearhead intricate quality improvement projects, cultivate a standard of clinical excellence within a distributed team, and champion the implementation of evolving AI technologies. In this capacity, the physician acts as the ultimate point for clinical escalations and manages oversight via collaborative practice agreements in various states.

Your Responsibilities and Impact Will Include:

Clinical Leadership & Patient Care (~70% of time):

  • Clinical Care for Transitions of Care: Deliver high-quality direct virtual patient care to patients recently discharged from the acute setting who are at high risk for readmission, focusing on complex transitions of care cases.

  • Clinical Escalations: Serve as the final escalation point for clinical questions and complex patient management decisions within your assigned interdisciplinary care team.

  • Clinical Outcomes Oversight: Oversee a narrow set of quality and clinical outcome metrics that are critical drivers of improved readmission rates.

Team Management & Clinical Supervision (~30% of time):

  • Clinical Supervision & Collaborative Practice: Provide supervision, teaching, and coaching to a team of Nurse Practitioners through collaborative practice agreements across multiple states, fostering a collaborative and supportive clinical environment.

  • Lead Interdisciplinary Rounds: Conduct weekly interdisciplinary rounds (3 hours/week) and readmission conferences to review high-risk patients, complex cases, and conduct deep-dive root cause analyses.

  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Provide clinical oversight and coaching for professionals across multiple disciplines. Collaborate closely with operations leads and senior managers for nursing, medical assistants, and clinical coordinators.

  • Foster an Open Clinical Culture: Champion a patient-centered and open clinical culture, fostering trust, transparency, honesty, and empowerment within a distributed team across geographic locations.

Technology, Innovation & Quality Improvement:

  • Clinical Innovation & Root Cause Analysis: Identify opportunities to improve the model of care through root cause analyses, identifying patterns of readmissions, developing strategies to prevent hospital readmissions, and driving quality improvement initiatives.

  • Technology & AI Enablement: Utilize and provide feedback on Devoted's proprietary electronic health information system (Orinoco) and contribute to the development, training, and application of AI-enabled clinical tools to support care within the TOC service.

  • Change Management & Innovation: Thrive in an entrepreneurial, high-growth environment with a high capacity for change management and agility. Drive innovation and process improvements to enhance the delivery of transitions of care services.

  • Advocate for Care Equity: Advocate for healthcare equity and accessibility within the organization and community, particularly for vulnerable patients at risk for readmission.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree.

  • Board certification in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or related specialty.

  • Minimum 3 years of post-residency clinical experience

  • Strong background in inpatient care and deep understanding of the transitions of care period.

  • Experience in the management of chronic medical diseases including heart failure, COPD, diabetes, hypertension, pneumonia, cellulitis, and urinary tract infections.

  • Experience leading interdisciplinary rounds and conducting deep-dive root cause analyses.

  • Direct experience supervising Nurse Practitioners or other healthcare professionals.

  • Proven ability to manage change, translate vision and strategy to front-line teams, and drive innovation in a dynamic healthcare environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience using data to drive clinical and operational improvements.

  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary teams and business partners

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Experience in hospital medicine, post-acute care, primary care, or geriatrics

  • Previous experience as a medical director or in a similar physician leadership role within value-based care or Medicare Advantage organizations.

  • Experience delivering care in a remote/virtual environment or with telehealth platforms.

  • Background in quality improvement methodologies and leading clinical initiatives.

  • Experience working in high-growth healthcare organizations

  • Experience serving diverse patient populations, with a focus on delivering care that aligns with our mission.

  • Entrepreneurial, growth-minded, and adaptable team player who is ready to innovate on transitional care delivery models within high-growth healthcare organizations.

Licensure and Certification:

  • Active medical license in good standing, with the ability and willingness to obtain licensure in additional states as the program expands (with support provided by Devoted).

  • Board certification in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or related specialty.

Salary Range: $280,000 – $338,000 / year plus eligibility for discretionary performance-based bonus paid out annually (Target bonus is 10%, payout based on terms of the bonus plan).

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary:

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who owns the technical strategy and platform evolution behind a key product line — someone who thinks in platforms rather than features, operates with AI tools as core infrastructure, and translates deep technical work into clear business impact.


This role sits at the interface of Product and Engineering. You will own the technical roadmap for your area — new capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt, security, and scaling — and keep Architecture and Engineering aligned with the business-facing teams that depend on them. You should already be using AI to accelerate your own work, be comfortable reading architecture diagrams and reviewing API designs, and bring strong opinions about how SaaS platforms should be designed, measured, and scaled. Your work will help our customers reach their goals and drive Momentive’s growth forward.


This position reports to the Director of Product Management. This is a remote, US-based position.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create, own, and maintain the technical product roadmap for your area — spanning new features and capabilities, platform infrastructure, technical debt remediation, security fixes, and scaling mechanisms.
  • Develop an in-depth understanding of the platform architecture and how it interacts with product use cases, the broader Momentive portfolio, and third-party integrations.
  • Translate product-line needs and stakeholder input into clear technical requirements, initiatives, and epics for Engineering — identifying shared patterns and consolidating duplicated efforts into scalable, reusable capabilities.
  • Maintain alignment between Architecture/Engineering teams and Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and other non-R&D functions — translating complex platform decisions into clear business-impact narratives.
  • Work with Support to triage and prioritize operational issues impacting customers and the broader platform.
  • Drive Product/Architecture interface process improvement, ensuring clean handoffs and shared accountability across teams.
  • Monitor platform adoption, usage, performance, and reliability metrics, and use data to drive technical investment decisions.
  • Act as Product Owner when needed, operating with high autonomy in a role where success depends on influence across teams you do not directly control.
  • Use AI tools as core tools in your daily work — not as novelties, but as force multipliers for research, analysis, communication, and decision-making:
  • Use AI to prototype technical approaches, analyze cross-product usage data, and generate first-draft technical specifications and requirements that you then refine with engineering judgment.
  • Compress discovery and analysis cycles by using AI to synthesize stakeholder input, assess existing systems and data flows, and surface insights that would otherwise take weeks.
  • Stay current on AI tooling and platform patterns, and share effective approaches with the broader product and engineering organization.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent work experience; 5+ years in a software/SaaS environment, including 4+ years in a product management role.
  • Advanced technical understanding of networking, databases, operating systems, APIs, microservices, and cloud infrastructure — with the depth to read architecture diagrams, review API designs, and engage in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
  • Experience defining APIs, data contracts, and integration approaches, and managing platform or system migrations while maintaining continuity for dependent teams and customers.
  • Advanced understanding of Agile processes and deployment methodologies, including CI/CD; strong grasp of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated, meaningful use of AI tools in your own workflow. You should be able to speak concretely to how AI has changed the way you work, what it’s replaced, and where you’ve found its limits.
  • Ability to derive and apply technical product strategy across one or more products on a 6–12 month time horizon, grounded in strong market and portfolio analysis.
  • Experience with secure coding, compliance, and security practices.
  • Strong experience with Jira and metrics tracking for optimal team output.
  • Experience working with Associations and/or Nonprofits is a plus.

Ideal Candidate Attributes:

  • Platform Thinker: Thinks in systems rather than features — building capabilities that scale across products and serve multiple teams through a shared core.
  • Technically Fluent: Comfortable in deep technical discussions with engineers, and able to translate complex architecture into clear narratives for leadership, product peers, and GTM teams.
  • Outcome-Focused: Draws a clear line from technical decisions to customer success and business results, and uses data to drive investment and prioritization.
  • Influential Leader: Drives outcomes across teams they do not directly control, building alignment and shared accountability through influence.
  • AI-Native: Treats AI as a core part of the job, not a novelty. Uses it daily to prototype, analyze, and communicate, and shares what works with the team.
  • Owner: Demonstrates significant initiative and end-to-end ownership, with an uncompromising commitment to product quality, reliability, performance, and scalability.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Funcionarios/as en activo o en excedencia y preparadores/as de oposiciones con experiencia en alguna de las oposiciones anteriores.

  • Personas que sepan enseñar, comunicar y hacer sencillo lo difícil. No buscamos solo expertos en un temario.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil, especialidad y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online dinámicas, prácticas y cercanas.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Vídeos cortos y cápsulas de contenido.

  • Temarios, esquemas y resúmenes.

  • Preguntas tipo test, supuestos prácticos y simulacros orientados al examen.

  • Nuevas formas de enseñar apoyándote en herramientas digitales e IA.

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

Job Summary

Your Career

As the Principal for Competitive Intelligence within the Cortex Product Management organization, you are the strategic link between the competitive landscape and our product roadmap. You don't just report on the market; you influence what we build. By applying Structured Analytic Techniques (SATs) to technical competitive data, you will provide the "Inconvenient Truths" that challenge our product assumptions. You will be responsible for ensuring that Cortex doesn't just match competitor features, but maintains a structural architectural advantage that is validated by evidence and field reality.

Your Impact

  • Use Structured Analytic Techniques (like Analysis of Competing Hypotheses and Alternative Futures Analysis) to identify upcoming competitor pivots, ensuring the Cortex roadmap accounts for "next-gen" threats before they materialize in the field.

  • Ownership of DSPM + CIEM + ITDR portfolio, acting as the direct liaison and influencer to the Product Management organization. You will translate deep research results into Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), prioritize feature gaps based on competitive urgency, and present key takeaways to senior leaders.

  • Partner with the Enablement Lead to turn strategic product insights into "Kill" campaigns. When the competition launches a new capability, you define our immediate product-level counter-narrative.

  • Perform deep-dive assessments into competitor technical capabilities to identify where PANW has a "Technical Moat" and where we are at risk of commoditization.

  • Go beyond CRM data to conduct structured analytic deep dives on significant losses, delivering actionable product feedback to Engineering and PM leadership to remove technical friction in the sales cycle.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 8+ years in CI, Product Management, or Sales Engineering within the Cybersecurity space (DSPM, CIEM, DLP, IAM, PAM, & JIT).

  • Mastery of Structured Analytic Techniques. You must be able to move beyond "feature checklists" to produce high-nuance analysis that can withstand questioning from senior Product and Engineering leaders.

  • You can read a technical spec and understand the downstream implications for an enterprise security architect. You aren't just looking at the UI; you are looking at the architecture.

  • A core requirement for this team. You must be comfortable telling Product Leaders where their product is failing against the competition and backing it up with evidence.

  • Proven mastery in distilling high-density technical data and complex market signals into concise, high-impact "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) briefings. (You must demonstrate the ability to strip away technical noise to deliver clear, actionable recommendations that direct-influence Product and Executive decision-making.)

  • Experience facilitating "Red Hat" analytic sessions for product launches to identify how competitors will likely attack our new features.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a PM or TMM is a significant plus, as you will need to speak the language of engineering trade-offs.

  • Experience in Structured All-Source Analysis or other formal intelligence frameworks used to evaluate technical claims.

  • Deep familiarity with how security products are actually deployed and used in a 24/7 SOC enterprise environment.

  • CI Certification like CIP or similar.

jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior ASIC Package Design Engineer to implement advanced ASIC package architecture, with a strong focus on flip-chip BGA (FC-BGA) and multi-chip module (MCM) solutions. This role supports the end-to-end package strategy for high-performance mixed-signal and digital SoCs from early architecture and trade studies through vendor engagement, qualification, and production ramp. You will collaborate with internal teams for package design, defining standards, influencing silicon and system architecture, and ensuring first-pass success for complex, high-speed, power-dense ASICs.

Responsibilities

  • Define ASIC package architecture for FC-BGA and MCM solutions, including substrate stack-up, ball-map strategy, power delivery, signal breakout, and mechanical constraints.
  • Lead package-level trade studies across cost, performance, power integrity (PI), signal integrity (SI), thermal, manufacturability, and reliability.
  • Establish package design standards, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Drive detailed design of FC-BGA packages for high-pin-count ASICs with high-speed SerDes, dense power grids, and RF signal content.
  • Define and review substrate stack-ups, via strategies, impedance control, escape routing, and reference plane planning.
  • Partner with silicon, RF, and systems teams to co-optimize die floorplans and package interfaces.
  • Support package-level SI/PI strategy, including high-speed digital interfaces, power delivery network (PDN) design, and decoupling strategy
  • Lead thermal architecture at the package level, including lid selection, TIMs, heat-spreaders, and mechanical interfaces to system cooling.
  • Manage relationships with external packaging vendors, substrate suppliers, and
    OSATs.
  • Drive material selection, substrate technology choices, and assembly process optimization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in ASIC package design, with deep expertise in FC-BGA.
  • Proven experience delivering high-pin-count, high-performance ASIC packages into production.
  • Strong understanding of substrate technologies and materials, SI/PI fundamentals at the package level, and thermal management for power-dense ASICs.
  • Fluent in SI/PI and EM simulation tools such as SIWave, HFSS, and ADS.
  • Experience working directly with OSATs and substrate vendors.
  • Knowledge of packaging qualification and test methodologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MCM or heterogeneous integration (chiplets, interposers, advanced laminates).
  • Background in high-speed digital or mixed-signal SoCs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace, space, or high-reliability electronics.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $180,000 – $260,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

Turnitin's Revenue Operations team is modernizing its analytics foundation — moving to governed dbt models on Redshift and building a trusted, consolidated view of the business for Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance.

  • A systems thinker who looks upstream and downstream before proposing a fix.
  • Someone constructively skeptical who reconciles the numbers before shipping them.
  • Impact-focused — you deliver the "so what?", not just the data.

Essential

Global Equity Settlement

    • Allocation issues

  • Partner closely with trading, finance, compliance, counterparties, and custodians to drive timely resolution of settlement issues.

Operational Risk & Regulatory Controls

  • Ensure operational processes comply with applicable SEC, FINRA, and global market regulations.
  • Support compliance with SEC Rule 15c3-3 by helping maintain proper possession and control of customer securities.
  • Identify operational risks and escalate issues that may impact clients, settlement, or regulatory obligations.

  • Assist the Director of Brokerage Operations with Internal Audit requests, regulatory examinations, and remediation efforts.

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Update operational procedures, controls, and documentation as business processes evolve.

Who You Are

We are seeking an experienced Azure Databricks Administrator to manage, maintain, secure, and optimize Databricks environments in Azure. This role is focused on platform administration, governance, operational support, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency across the organization’s data analytics infrastructure.

The successful candidate will serve as a platform administrator and operational partner to data engineering, analytics, cybersecurity, compliance, and business teams, helping ensure Databricks is reliable, well-governed, secure, and effectively supported.

  • Configure, maintain, and administer Azure Databricks workspaces and clusters across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Monitor cluster health, performance metrics, resource utilization, and platform availability.
  • Optimize cluster, SQL warehouse, and workspace configurations for performance and cost efficiency.
  • Manage workspace governance, including job scheduling, notebook organization, audit logging, and operational standards.
  • Administer user access, workspace permissions, SQL warehouse configurations, and group-based security controls.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure issues, performance bottlenecks, connectivity problems, and workload failures.
  • Support disaster recovery and high-availability planning, validation, and operational readiness for Databricks workloads.

  • Maintain documentation and runbooks for operational procedures.
  • Support capacity planning, cost optimization, and platform improvement initiatives.

    • Security Governance

    • Administer Unity Catalog permissions, metastore access, catalogs, schemas, tables, volumes, and external locations to enforce governed data access.
    • Manage workspace permissions, admin roles, service principals, groups, SCIM provisioning, and Microsoft Entra ID integration to support secure identity governance.
    • Configure and review compute policies, cluster permissions, instance pool access, SQL warehouse permissions, and job ownership to reduce unnecessary privilege and control platform usage.

    • Coordinate recurring access reviews, access certification, and timely remediation of excessive, inappropriate, or outdated permissions to support internal control requirements.
    • Review Databricks audit logs, security events, access changes, and control findings to identify risks, policy exceptions, segregation-of-duties concerns, and required remediation actions.
    • Support audit and regulatory readiness by maintaining evidence for access controls, configuration standards, policy enforcement, operational procedures, and change management activities.
    • Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, risk, infrastructure, and data governance teams to align Databricks controls with financial services security, privacy, and compliance expectations.

    • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Azure Databricks workspaces, Unity Catalog, clusters, jobs, SQL warehouses, and platform settings.
    • Strong experience managing Databricks users, groups, workspace permissions, admin roles, service principals, SCIM provisioning, and Microsoft Entra ID integration.
    • Experience administering Unity Catalog, including metastores, catalogs, schemas, tables, volumes, permissions, storage credentials, and external locations.
    • Ability to configure and maintain compute policies, cluster permissions, instance pools, SQL warehouses, job ownership, and platform usage controls.
    • Experience monitoring Databricks platform health, cluster performance, job execution, workload failures, audit logs, and resource utilization.
    • Strong troubleshooting skills for Databricks platform issues, Spark workloads, connectivity problems, permission errors, and performance bottlenecks.
    • Working knowledge of Python, SQL, PowerShell, Databricks CLI, REST APIs, and automation practices used to support platform administration.
    • Experience supporting operational controls, access reviews, audit evidence, change management, runbooks, and platform documentation.
    • Knowledge of Databricks security governance, RBAC, least privilege, encryption, secrets management, audit readiness, and secure data access patterns.
    • Understanding of Azure networking and security concepts, including private endpoints, firewalls, network security groups, storage access, Key Vault, and secure connectivity.
    • Experience partnering with data engineering teams to support reliable pipelines, workload troubleshooting, performance tuning, platform standards, and secure Databricks operations.
    • Travel requirement: All roles require travel during the first 6 months of employment to attend the BHG Oars in Experience. After the initial 6 months, ongoing travel is expected at approximately ~5% annually for periodic team on-sites, team meetings, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Work Authorization: This role is not eligible for employer-provided immigration sponsorship. To be considered, applicants must already possess valid U.S. work authorization that will not require sponsorship now or in the future.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
The Engineering Manager is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You are embedded with your team - daily standup, code review, architectural calls, delivery planning, and performance management - and you own both the team's output and the team's growth.
This is a genuinely technical & leadership role. You are expected to write and review code, be a credible voice in architectural decisions, and stay current in your team's stack. You lead by demonstrating you can do the work at the highest level, not by title alone.The balance between hands-on contribution and leadership depends on the team's context, but your overarching mandate is the same: run the team, execute and deliver, and grow its impact.
Build the bench, raise the standard, and keep the operating cadence sharp as the work and the organization evolve. You work AI-augmented yourself, expect the same from your team, and push the team's craft forward with every new capability that lands.

Responsibilities
Team leadership & growth

  • Leading a team of engineers, owning both its delivery and its development.
  • Lead a mindset and process of continuous improvement within the team and meaningfully impact the team’s success over time. Small, compounding improvements, delivered via fast iterations, are the operating rhythm we expect, not an aspiration.
  • You are responsible for the professional well-being and career development of team members. Develop engineers through regular 1:1s, growth plans, performance reviews, and direct, candid feedback.
  • Develop the next layer of leadership - tech leads, senior engineers ready to manage, and ICs ready to step into staff roles.

    Technical leadership
  • Write code and review code. Be a credible voice in technical decisions because you have hands in the work, not because of your title - you are current, not rusty.
  • Drive the team's architectural and technical design decisions in partnership with senior ICs, ensuring alignment on approach and implementation.
  • Uphold engineering standards through thorough, constructive pull-request review and a healthy release process, keeping the team's components scalable and in a healthy state.
  • Work AI-augmented and lead an AI-augmented team, applying sharp judgment about where AI helps and holding the same quality bar for what ships.

    Roadmap & delivery
  • Own the team's commitments - what was promised, when it was promised, and the quality bar that was held.
  • Run a disciplined cadence of planning, prioritization, and delivery without becoming a process bureaucrat.
  • Partner closely with the Technical Product Owner and Product team on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, maintaining a roadmap that reflects both near-term priorities and longer-term direction.
  • Understand the broader business objectives behind the work, translate that context for the team, and ensure engineering effort clearly aligns with those objectives.
  • React decisively to change - re-planning, re-prioritizing, and re-staffing as the business moves - while keeping the team engaged and steady through the shift.

    Hiring
  • Own hiring for your team. Interview thoughtfully, decide quickly, and refuse to lower the bar to fill seats.
  • Recruit, coach, and - when needed - make hard calls toward the standard the team is held to.
  • Operate as a role model for other engineering managers across the organization: share your operating model, mentor peers, and raise the management bench.
  • Day-to-day communication & collaborationUpwards: Communicate clearly and succinctly, giving leadership the right level of context and prioritizing escalations based on relevant, well-gathered information.
  • Downwards: Empower senior engineers to own key areas of the product, and coach team members to stay focused, intentional, and aware of their impact.
  • Sideways: Partner effectively with Product, Design, GTM, Customer Success, and other teams - raising challenges and opportunities constructively to support cross-team alignment.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering management roles where you actively coded as part of your responsibilities.
  • Hands-on, real-life experience building cloud-based SaaS products - running services in production for Azure (and ideally additionally on AWS/GCP) , and owning availability, cost, and the customer-facing surface
  • Strong background in understanding and leading teams in the FinOps space.
  • API first mindset, products are built not just for end user experience through UI,they are fully functional and available through APIs, so both humans and agents can interact with the platform.
  • Strong background in engineering management of multi-disciplinary teams, including full-stack engineers and data engineers.
  • A track record of taking an engineering team and visibly transforming it - measurable improvements in delivery velocity, technical quality, or team caliber.
  • Deep technical fluency in your team's primary stack. You can read, write, and review code at a senior level, and you are current - not rusty.
  • Strong opinions on how high-performing engineering teams operate, and a clear philosophy on hiring, coaching, performance management, and technical decision-making.
  • Excellent judgment under pressure. You make calls quickly with imperfect information, communicate them clearly, and take responsibility for the outcomes.
  • Direct, candid communication. You give hard feedback well, and you hear it well.

    Bonus Points
  • Strong Golang knowledge or experience
  • A strong, already-established AI-augmented workflow, with opinions on how to apply AI tools and agentic workflows to raise both velocity and quality.
  • Hands-on experience with more than a single cloud provider.
  • Background in scaling teams, processes, or technical systems as the organization grows.

Are you a Do’er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One Team
DoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.title: Data Analyst II
jobs.excerpt: About UsYipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy.
jobs.description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy. Our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights. The world's top investment funds and Fortune 500 companies depend on our data to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It's Like to Work Here

  • Ownership is real, not aspirational. An analyst here can own a data product end-to-end—from methodology to client delivery—and directly influence products used by many of the world's largest investment firms.
  • Growth is driven by impact, not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. We promote based on what you've done, not how long you've been here.
  • AI is a core working tool. We're actively rebuilding how analytical work gets done—using AI agents, automation, and new tooling to fundamentally change what's possible. If you're excited by that, you'll thrive here.

About the Role

YipitData's Data Feeds team transforms our proprietary datasets into commercial data products used by many of the world's largest hedge funds, asset managers, and quantitative investors. Our products help investors answer questions about consumer spending, enterprise software adoption, cloud infrastructure, healthcare, and dozens of other markets—using proprietary datasets that clients integrate directly into their investment workflows.

The Data Feeds team creates products that fit seamlessly into client investment workflows—whether that's through granular datasets, aggregated metrics, forecasting methodologies, APIs, or entirely new AI-powered product experiences.

As an analyst on the team, you'll sit at the intersection of analytics, product, and commercialization. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Central Data, Data Science, Engineering, Quant Research, and Client Strategy to continuously improve how clients consume and derive value from our data.

We're hiring across multiple products, including:

  • Kepler — consumer transaction datasets powering institutional investment workflows through granular transaction data, aggregated metrics, and forecasting products.
  • Summit — B2B spend datasets built from purchase and invoice data, helping investors understand enterprise software, industrials, healthcare, and other sectors.
  • Edison – email receipt datasets built from one of the industry's largest anonymized inbox panels, helping investors track consumer purchases, subscriptions, travel, and digital commerce across thousands of merchants.
  • SpendHound – Proprietary B2B software spend datasets built from ERP, expense, and invoice data, helping investors understand software adoption, customer retention, competitive dynamics, and enterprise technology spending.
  • Cloud – Enterprise cloud infrastructure data covering AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud, combining proprietary spend panels with pricing and capacity data to help investors understand cloud growth, AI infrastructure demand, and competitive dynamics.

This role is different from a traditional Data Analyst position. Success isn't measured by how many analyses you complete. It's measured by the quality of the products you build, the customer problems you solve, and the leverage you create for clients and the business.

We’re open to hiring this role at multiple levels. While the position is posted as Senior Data Analyst, we encourage applications from candidates with a range of experience who can demonstrate strong analytical judgment, ownership, and growth potential. Final title, scope, and compensation will be calibrated based on experience and demonstrated skills.

As an analyst on the Data Feeds team, you will:

  • Own commercial data products – Own products end-to-end, from methodology development and product QA to feature design and ongoing product evolution. Develop deep expertise in how your product works and the investment workflows it supports.
  • Improve product quality through systems – Investigate complex data quality issues spanning upstream datasets, product methodologies, and downstream customer outputs. Build scalable monitoring, validation, and QA frameworks that improve quality while reducing manual effort.
  • Shape the evolution of the product – Work with Product Managers, Data Science, and Central Data. Identify opportunities for new methodologies, additional datasets, forecasting capabilities, AI-powered features, and entirely new product offerings.
  • Evaluate new data and methodologies – Analyze new internal and third-party datasets to determine whether they improve product accuracy, coverage, or customer value. Design experiments, quantify tradeoffs, and help determine what belongs in production.
  • Turn customer feedback into better products - Partner with Product Managers, Client Strategy and directly with sophisticated investors to understand how products are being used. Translate customer questions, trial feedback, and support escalations into durable product improvements.
  • Use AI to redesign analytical workflows – Leverage AI agents, automation, and evaluation frameworks to improve QA, documentation, methodology development, and customer-facing analytical experiences.
  • Build the next generation of data products – Look beyond maintaining today's products. Identify opportunities to create new analytical capabilities, improve client workflows, and expand the ways customers interact with our data.

Example Projects

Over your first year, you might:

  • Design a new aggregation methodology that significantly improves the accuracy of a commercial transaction product.
  • Evaluate a new third-party dataset and determine whether it should become part of a production product.
  • Build automated QA monitors that proactively detect regressions before customers notice them.
  • Partner with Data Science to evaluate the impact of model improvements on customer-facing metrics.
  • Create an AI-powered workflow that dramatically reduces the time required to investigate complex customer-reported data issues.
  • Launch a new forecasting capability or AI-powered analytical feature that expands how clients use our products.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 4+ years of experience in data analytics, with a background in financial services, consulting, data science, product analytics, or another environment where complex data informs high-stakes decisions.
  • You have advanced SQL skills and experience using Python or PySpark to build reliable, reusable analytical workflows.
  • You enjoy building products—not just analyzing data—and naturally think about how information should be packaged, delivered, and experienced by customers.
  • You quickly develop strong mental models for complex datasets and enjoy reasoning through ambiguity to identify root causes and improve methodologies.
  • You have led complex cross-functional projects involving Product, Engineering, or analytical stakeholders and are comfortable driving work from idea to execution.
  • You know how to balance rigor with pragmatism, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term product value.
  • You're skilled at working with messy, evolving datasets and enjoy creating structure, repeatability, and confidence in complex systems.
  • You communicate technical concepts clearly and can explain methodologies, assumptions, and tradeoffs to both technical teammates and business stakeholders.
  • You actively use AI tools and are excited about fundamentally changing how analytical products are built—not just making existing workflows more efficient.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • The annual base compensation for this position is anticipated to be $140K–$190K, reflecting the range of levels at which we may hire. Final title, scope, and compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

The total compensation package includes a mix of base, bonus, equity, and benefits

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Introduction to the Team & Role

What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.

  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

What You'll Do

  • Know the team, the stack, and the cross-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
  • Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
  • Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.

    • Within 3 months, you will:
  • Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
  • Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
  • Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
  • Have a 12-18 month roadmap, setting the high-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio

    • Within 12 months, you will:
  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
  • Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

The Skill Set

  • 5+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate.
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
  • Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead-to-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
  • Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
  • You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
  • You drive strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
  • Run vendor evaluations end to end
  • Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.

Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is hiring a Senior Service Designer / UX Researcher to join our Developer Experience team on a newly awarded platform engineering contract with the Department of Education's Federal Student Aid (FSA). FSA manages nearly $1.7 trillion in federal student loans and serves more than 45 million borrowers. This contract is building the platform engineering foundation that enables FSA's engineering teams to deliver faster, more securely, and with less friction.

You will be the embedded HCD practitioner on a four-person Developer Experience team, working alongside a Technical Product Manager, a Content/Documentation Specialist, and a Software Engineer. Your job is to make the platform something developers actually want to use. You'll map the end-to-end developer journey, identify friction, run sprint-cadence usability testing, and translate research directly into the backlog. The people you're designing for are software engineers and developers, not end users of a public-facing website, and that distinction matters.

Applicants must include a link to a portfolio of relevant work.

Location:

This is a fully remote position that can be worked anywhere in the U.S. While most of the work is expected to be conducted virtually, there is potential for occasional travel for on-site meetings and working sessions (Washington, D.C.) at the discretion of the client. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to contractual requirement.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $125,000 – $130,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Research and Discovery

  • Map the end-to-end developer journey from access request through first production deploy, identifying high-friction points at each stage.

  • Plan and execute sprint-cadence user research with FSA engineering teams using methods such as contextual inquiry, usability testing, interviews, and behavioral analytics.

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable insights and translate them directly into prioritized backlog items.

  • rack adoption metrics and developer satisfaction (Developer NPS) to measure the impact of improvements over time.

Service Design

  • Design service blueprints, interaction patterns, user flows, and high-fidelity prototypes for developer-facing products including the self-service portal, onboarding toolkit, and golden-path templates.

  • Deliver design specifications and documentation that reduce implementation ambiguity and improve fidelity between design intent and what gets built.

  • Collaborate with the team’s software engineer to keep the iteration loop tight within a single sprint cadence, ensuring research-backed interaction patterns are reflected in working software.

  • Design responsive, accessible interfaces that account for regulatory and secure interaction requirements without degrading usability.

  • Apply accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2.1) to all developer-facing interfaces and documentation experiences.

  • Contribute to a developer experience metrics dashboard, defining what gets measured and why.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with the team’s Technical Product Manager to align research priorities with the product roadmap and QASP performance measures.

  • Engage FSA engineering stakeholders to understand their workflows, constraints, and needs, building trust and buy-in for platform adoption.

  • Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives.

  • Coordinate with adjacent vendor teams and FSA stakeholders to ensure the developer experience serves the broader engineering ecosystem.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus at least eight (8) years of experience in service design, UX research, or human-centered design.

  • Proven ability to design intuitive, accessible, and production-ready experiences for complex, multi-step workflows serving large user populations.

  • Demonstrated experience reducing task friction, error rates, and avoidable support contacts through measurable design improvements.

  • Strong capability designing responsive digital experiences and system-driven UI behavior in collaboration with engineering teams.

  • Experience incorporating regulatory, accessibility, and secure interaction requirements into design artifacts without degrading usability.

  • Demonstrated expertise in applied research methods including contextual inquiry, usability testing, journey mapping, service blueprinting, and synthesis of qualitative and quantitative findings.

  • Experience conducting research with technical users, developers, or platform/tool users, and the ability to adapt methods appropriately for that audience.

  • Proven ability to translate research findings directly into prioritized backlog items, high-fidelity prototypes, specifications, and design documentation that reduce ambiguity and accelerate delivery.

  • Proficiency in Figma, Miro or FigJam, or equivalent collaborative design and whiteboarding tools.

  • Familiarity with developer tools and environments (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, portals, documentation systems) sufficient to understand the context developers work in.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Tier 4 / High Risk Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience working on developer experience, internal tooling, or platform-as-product initiatives.

  • Familiarity with the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS), the 21st Century IDEA, USDS Playbook, and other federal design standards.

  • Experience working within FedRAMP, FISMA, or other federal compliance environments.

  • Familiarity with DORA metrics, DevSecOps concepts, or agile platform engineering practices.

In this consultative role, you will leverage your creativity to find cleared and uncleared technical talent, helping staff positions in multiple locations, spanning a broad array of skillsets - supporting funded work and new business growth. In addition, you will report to ProSidian Management and keep Client Engagement Team Leads.

Our ideal Full-Cycle Recruiter is a dedicated, detail-oriented, self-motivated, trustworthy, resourceful, and creative individual who continues to expand on staffing and management experience. An exceptional communicator possesses a consultative sales style, outstanding problem-solving abilities, and a keen client assessment aptitude. Expert in discovery, pursuit, closing, and retention of candidates and clients. Ability to work well on a team and autonomously while leveraging available technology and platforms effectively.

The full cycle recruiting process at ProSidian as a Management and Operations Consulting Firm in general consists of seven (07) workstreams: 1) Requirement and Resource Preparations, 2) Sourcing and Strategic Resourcing, 3) Requirement and Candidate Screening, 4) Candidate and Partner Selection, 5) Hiring, Negotiating, and Scheduling, 6) Placement and On-boarding, 7) Proposal and Business Support.

  1. Requirement and Resource Preparations: inclusive job descriptions | posting to job boards and social media | managing the Employee Referral Program – prepare recruitment materials, and post jobs to appropriate job boards, define ideal candidates, determine qualifications, and connect with sector professionals and strategic resources. This includes but is not limited to .
  2. Sourcing and Strategic Resourcing: source candidates | check existing talent pool | keep management, client/pursuit teams informed and supported - integrated communication and early alignment with global strategic resources on current and upcoming requirements as well as options to extend for client engagements in various sectors across service and solution sectors and variety of engagements. Build and maintain relationships while working to generate a strong list of candidates (Active/Passive). Typically, this involves utilizing Sourcing and Strategic Resourcing tools (ZoomInfo, Smart Recruiters, LinkedIn Recruiter, Facebook, Sector Specific Portals such as RoadTechs) or manually researching candidates then sending personalized communication inviting them to apply through LinkedIn, email, text, and other channels.
  3. Requirement and Candidate Screening: screen resumes | provide job previews | engage sector ecosystems and applicant pools - engage in high volume recruiting for sector and client requirements while looking at metrics to optimize the number and rates for an employee (W-2), contract (1099), and teaming partner/subcontractor resources. This includes requirement analysis, candidate review, supporting partner and subcontractor data calls, and participating in strategies for negotiating and scheduling team member rates and availability.
  4. Candidate and Partner Selection: close contact | update recruitment notes | refine candidate pool | use interview guides for structured interviews | interview scheduling/candidate submissions - work with management, pursuit teams, client service liaisons, and necessary decision-makers to prepare and provide required materials to support data calls, determining bill/cost rates, determine resource availability, and facilitate technical reviews based on factors predictive of future job performance.
  5. Hiring, Negotiating, and scheduling: hiring | perform reference checks | do a background check | technical/skills test | support data-driven decision making - Help to make decisions that are consistent, compliant, and based on factors predictive of success (technical ability, availability, core competencies, sector experience, etc.) by helping to inform the strategic resourcing and recruitment process.
  6. Placement and On-Boarding: stay in touch | support pre-boarding | assist on-boarding - Once the paperwork is complete, work with firm/client management, ProSidian Operations, and the candidate to support placement and on-boarding, including working through compliance and employment documentation. The full cycle recruiter typically continues to be the point of contact for any questions while working with operations to establish and set up items such as payroll, compliance documentation, and client/team introductions.
  7. Proposal and Business Support: proposal development | capture management | proposal management | price-to-win & competitive assessment | business support - participate in processes to help manage and develop business opportunities at or before the final customer solicitation.
