jobs.description:
About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.
  • Capture page metadata: language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: every task is reviewed end to end by a second Bengali expert, and experienced annotators take on that review.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts: multi-column newspapers, exam papers, handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Regional-language AI data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation for training datasets.
  • Transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction or post-editing.
  • Document production: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Bengali-language material.
  • Script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Bengali input methods, numeral-form and character-form accuracy.

About the Remote Licensed Therapist (1099 Contractor) role at Headspace:

Headspace is currently seeking part-time, independently licensed contractor therapists to provide direct, virtual care as part of a multidisciplinary team on a 1099 contract basis.

To get started, we strongly encourage having 10+ hours available per week with full flexibility to adjust; more is always welcome depending on your schedule! Please note that due to care demand and member scheduling fluctuations, it could take a number of weeks to achieve a consistent schedule.

The pay range for the Contract Mental Health Therapist ranges from $69-$74 per teletherapy session. Exact reimbursement rates will be determined during the interview process and are based on a number of factors including but not limited to location, licensure type, experience, specializations, languages spoken, and populations treated.

Session length is 60 minutes for an intake and 45 minutes for a follow up appointment, with concurrent note-taking expected and included in the session rate. All Headspace therapists must be licensed and reside in the US. Due to the nature of healthcare services provided to our customers, partners and members, all work must be provided in the U.S. Data, specifically personal health information may not be accessed, disclosed or used outside of the U.S. Please note that the U.S. is limited to the 50 states of the United States -- it does not include U.S. territories like Puerto Rico.

Why Work on the Headspace Network:

  • Exceptional Care, backed by Clinical Expertise: Bring your deep expertise to a platform that delivers exceptional measurement-based care. Headspaces’ comprehensive training and clinical support teams will partner with you to ensure member success, while our robust quality assurance process ensures ongoing support–enhancing your practice and providing a framework for continuous improvement in clinical outcomes.
  • World Class Content Created by a Beloved Brand:Supplement your member support with thousands of expert-led exercises, mood-boosting meditations, and stress-relieving tools for all of life’s moments. Whether your members report feeling stressed or anxious, need support navigating their caregiver journey, or experiencing grief, our content supports individual goals with tools backed by research and delivered by trained mindfulness experts.
  • Seamless Support for You and Your Members: A dedicated team at Headspace handles the operational details, allowing you to concentrate on what you do best — delivering high quality care. With intentional communication, a suite of administrative and clinical tools, and resources, we ensure providers and members feel supported every step of the way.
  • Education That Empowers Excellence: Benefit from access to a best-in-class training institute that prioritizes pragmatic, evidence-based approaches to transdiagnostic care and culturally responsive practice. Our education program promotes continuous skill development, improving your clinical expertise while expanding your knowledge and capabilities.
  • A Community of Care: Join a network of peers and Headspace experts with opportunities to collaborate, connect, and grow together while delivering on our mission to provide every person access to lifelong mental health support.

What you will do:

  • Provide high quality, innovative, tele-therapy to Headspace patients over a HIPAA compliant video conferencing platform
  • Complete, sign and lock clinical case notes in EMR within 48 hours of session as part of the per-session reimbursement rate.
  • Maintain your personalized database to record proof of licensure, license updates, expiration dates, personal information, etc.
  • Keep your availability calendar up to date
  • Work with a collaborative care team including health coaches, other therapists, psychiatrists, and external care providers

What you will bring:

  • 3+ years experience providing clinical psychotherapy to individuals, couples or families

An independent clinical license to practice in good standing (without need for clinical supervision), at the Master or Doctoral levelBC-TMH credential, if required by your state of license

  • Ability to offer at least 10 sessions per week for bookings, with the ability to flex up or down as needed
    • Night and weekend flexibility a plus
  • Clinical competence in evidence-based practices (CBT, DBT, ACT, Mindfulness, etc.) and measurement-based care
  • Experience with risk management and higher acuity cases
  • Knowledge, ability, and commitment to providing culturally responsive care
  • Familiarity, comfort and confidence with care delivery technology - various applications, tech tools, google web-apps, video conferencing, EMR, etc.
  • A safe secure location with reliable internet connection to provide Zoom-based psychotherapy
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work within interdisciplinary teams

Preferred (if applicable)

  • Licensure in multiple states
  • Licensed psychologist with willingness to apply for (or is already enrolled) with PSYPACT
  • Ability to deliver care to a variety of populations
  • Multilingual
  • Familiarity with the Headspace app and content
  • Willingness to include evening availability in your schedule to support member care flexibility

Privacy Statement

All member records are protected according to our Privacy Policy. Further, while employees and contractors of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.

Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. Such steps would be taken to protect both the former member, as well as any relevant individuals from their care team, from impairment, risk of exploitation, or harm.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced compliance and financial crime leader to help shape and expand our work across anti money laundering, virtual asset compliance, and blockchain risk management. This role is designed for someone who understands compliance from both sides of the market: traditional financial institutions and virtual asset service providers. You should be comfortable operating at the intersection of regulation, financial crime prevention, blockchain analytics, and commercial strategy. You will serve as a senior subject matter expert on AML and virtual asset compliance, helping the company strengthen its compliance capabilities, advise financial institutions and VASPs, and engage credibly with regulators, law enforcement agencies, clients, and industry partners.

About You

You are a practical and commercially minded compliance leader with deep experience in AML, financial crime, and virtual assets.
You have worked within, or closely alongside, both traditional financial institutions and VASPs, and understand the differences between conventional transaction monitoring and the risks presented by blockchain based financial activity. You are equally comfortable reviewing a complex financial crime case, designing an AML framework, advising senior leadership, speaking with a regulator, and explaining blockchain risk to a bank, exchange, or government stakeholder. You do not approach compliance as a purely administrative function. You understand how strong compliance programs, credible risk controls, and effective blockchain analytics can support responsible business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve AML frameworks, virtual asset compliance strategy, sanctions, risk assessments, transaction monitoring, and investigation processes.
  • Advise financial institutions and VASPs on virtual asset compliance, regulatory expectations, and blockchain related financial crime risks.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and translate them into practical compliance guidance and product requirements.
  • Where applicable, serve as MLRO or support the designated MLRO on suspicious activity reviews and regulatory reporting.
  • Partner with product, engineering, business development teams, regulators, law enforcement, and other industry stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Prior experience as an MLRO, Chief Compliance Officer, Head of Financial Crime, or a similar senior compliance role.
  • Experience across both traditional financial institutions and the virtual asset industry.
  • Strong knowledge of AML, financial crime, sanctions, transaction monitoring, regulatory compliance and reporting, and virtual asset financial crime risks.
  • Hands on experience with blockchain analytics, KYT, wallet screening, or similar on-chain compliance tools and processes.
  • Strong communication skills and CAMS or an equivalent AML qualification.

Bonus Points

  • Experience owning the AML program of a regulated entity, VASP licensing, regulatory examinations, or remediation.
  • Established relationships across regulators, law enforcement, banks, exchanges, or the virtual asset industry.

Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That's why people love us.
We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies.
And there's so much more to do! We're expanding the product in many directions, and continuously reevaluating decisions we made in the past in order to improve every flow and detail. We want to do that faster and even better, so we're looking for outcome-oriented, seasoned Product Designers to join our core team. At Metabase, design directly drives business success: our customers consistently choose us because of our superior UX — meaning your work will be directly responsible for our growth.
Product designers at Metabase are part of a centralized team, working closely with small teams of engineers to design and ship beautiful, simple solutions from beginning to end.

We have a unique design culture:

  • We focus on solving root problems rather than applying superficial fixes
  • We care more about a solution “feeling” right than rigidly adhering to “consistency”
  • We ship iteratively and value real-world outcomes over “perfect” process or glossy internal artifacts

Recent projects our designers have tackled include:

  • Creating a completely new Documents feature
  • Envisioning a new way to view, compare, and explore metrics
  • Creating patterns and surfaces for LLM-based SQL generation, natural language queries, and asynchronous agentic work

Responsibilities

  • Deliver end-to-end design solutions that are truly elegant, beautiful, fun, and simple.
  • Push back on complexity creeping into the product.
  • Use a variety of mediums to communicate what could or should be done, whether it’s LLM-generated prototypes, writing, Figjam diagrams, or high fidelity concepts and solutions.
  • Pull on engineers and product thinkers to ensure understanding of technical constraints and possibilities.
  • Iterate rapidly and broadly in scrappy ways that make abstract ideas tangible and which move conversations forward.
  • Deeply internalize the needs and mindset of our users through insights provided by the broader team. UX research skills aren't needed, but welcome.

Profile

  • You think in terms of journeys, not screens.
  • Biased toward building things, not slide decks.
  • Work out-in-the-open instinctively, out of an eagerness to receive feedback, and to riff and iterate with an experienced, skilled team.
  • Thorough and attentive to detail, with a high internal bar for your craft.
  • Strong ability to communicate design decisions and rationales through speaking and writing.
  • Comfortable with asynchronous collaboration, and articulating complex ideas remotely.

Skills and experience

  • Depth of experience designing solutions for challenging product problems. Your work will rely on research and analytics, but it will shine because of solid instincts and craftsmanship.
  • Experience designing specifically for large web applications/tools
  • Technical enough to understand at a high level what's happening inside the engineering black-boxes. (If you don't understand the complexity, how can you simplify it?)

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM-based UI and interaction prototyping
  • Experience with Web development (HTML, CSS, React)
  • Technical background or education (CS degree or similar)
  • Experience building or using developer tools
Compensation

Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors.

We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment.
We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We're relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come.

jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.

In this role, you'll build and run Affirm's end-to-end security review process for enterprise AI/LLM systems evaluating architecture, prioritizing AI-specific risks, and designing the controls and guardrails that let Affirm adopt AI safely, partnering across Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, IT, and Engineering to make it scalable and repeatable.

What you’ll do

  • You will lead and continuously improve Affirm's enterprise AI security review process evaluating the architecture, data flows, permissions, and design of internal AI tools, agentic/MCP-based systems, and AI features — and embed security requirements into the design phase.
  • You will threat model AI/LLM-based systems and their data flows for risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool-permission abuse, data poisoning, and sensitive-data exposure, and drive remediation.
  • You will review source code, system prompts, agent configurations, and tool/permission manifests (e.g., MCP definitions), and help tool owners build security-focused test cases and red-team/eval scenarios to verify requirements before launch.
  • You will design and build security guardrails and tooling for AI systems permission boundaries, authn/authz for agentic tools and MCP servers, data-handling controls, logging/monitoring, and policy-as-code (Python, IaC) — to enforce and automate AI security.
  • You will evaluate the AI capabilities of third-party SaaS vendors (e.g., Notion, Slack, Google Workspace) as part of vendor and SaaS security reviews and drive risk-based adoption decisions.
  • You will identify emerging classes of AI/agentic security vulnerabilities, develop mitigations before they become incidents, and contribute to AI-specific incident response playbooks as a senior escalation point.
  • You will lead cross-functional AI security initiatives to closure, advise technical and executive stakeholders as an internal point of expertise, and stay current on the AI security landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) to translate new research into practical controls.

What we look for

  • You are a seasoned security engineer with hands-on experience designing, evaluating, and maintaining security architecture for AI/LLM-based systems, plus deep expertise in enterprise security systems, processes, and controls.
  • You have practical experience threat modeling and reviewing AI/LLM applications (e.g., against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and securing agentic systems and tool-calling frameworks — MCP servers/clients, tool-permission models, and agent-to-tool trust boundaries.
  • You have built AI governance artifacts (acceptable use policy, data-handling standards, vendor/model risk assessments) and evaluated AI capabilities within SaaS platforms (e.g., Notion AI, Slack AI, Google Workspace AI, GitHub Copilot) as part of vendor reviews.
  • You have experience with enterprise tools for AI visibility and control (e.g., CASB, IDP/Okta) and familiarity with the corporate systems where AI is adopted (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Jira).
  • You can build security tooling, guardrails, and detections with Python or similar, and deploy cloud services and policy-as-code using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar); familiarity with Kubernetes and AWS.
  • You understand how LLMs and agentic systems are built (RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, tool use) and authn/authz models (OAuth2, SAML, service-account/non-human identities) for agentic and machine-to-machine access, with strong application-architecture and threat-modeling fundamentals.
  • You can lead cross-functional initiatives across Security, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance and drive them to closure, and communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences. Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, PCI DSS) and applying IAM to non-human/agent identities is a plus.

Base Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 13

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

The Associate Director, Medical Affairs serves as a scientific leader and subject matter expert within Kaléo’s Medical Affairs team. The position independently leads defined Medical Affairs workstreams encompassing key thought leader engagement, congress scientific activities, Medical Affairs booth strategy, scientific communications, publications, literature surveillance, insight generation, and medical inquiry support. The Associate Director translates scientific evidence and stakeholder insights into actionable recommendations that advance Medical Affairs strategy and provides trained backup support for selected Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities in accordance with established procedures.

This role combines external scientific engagement with visible ownership of high-value Medical Affairs programs. As Associate Director, Medical Affairs, you will help advance scientific understanding within the healthcare professional community, expand organizational capacity for congress activities and evidence communication, and provide practical scientific leadership across the product lifecycle. You will have the opportunity to support potentially life-saving products while working within a passionate, purpose-driven culture and a highly collaborative, close-knit team committed to excellence.

As the Associate Director, Medical Affairs you will:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert within Kaléo, translating clinical evidence, stakeholder insights, and emerging scientific developments into strategic recommendations that advance Medical Affairs objectives.
  • Develop and maintain compliant relationships with KTLs and other external scientific experts; plan and conduct scientific exchanges, and support development and execution of congress meetings, advisory boards, roundtables, consensus initiatives, and other engagements aligned with Medical Affairs strategy.

  • Support publication activities, including publication planning, literature reviews, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, white papers, and review through applicable publication governance processes.
  • Conduct literature surveillance and synthesize relevant scientific, clinical, safety, and competitive developments for internal stakeholders; identify potential implications for Medical Affairs strategy, evidence generation, education, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Lead or support the aggregation and analysis of insights from KTL interactions, congresses, Medical Affairs booths, advisory boards, Medical Information, surveys, and research activities to help identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.
  • Represent Medical Affairs on cross-functional teams and provide scientific expertise to internal stakeholders, including Regulatory, Quality, and Commercial colleagues, as appropriate.
  • Serve as a trained, designated backup for defined Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities, including Medical Information call center oversight, review or escalation of medical inquiries, identification and escalation of reportable safety information, and medical assessment of selected product complaints.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities consistent with the scope and level of the position, as assigned.

  • Ability to build credible, compliant relationships with KTLs, healthcare professionals, and other external scientific experts.
  • Strong scientific presentation skills and the ability to tailor complex information to scientific, executive, and cross-functional audiences.

  • Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration and influence while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs independence.
  • Strong project and program leadership, including the ability to manage competing priorities, complex workstreams, and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Ability to aggregate and synthesize insights to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.
  • Strong quality, compliance, and risk awareness, including recognition and escalation of safety, product quality, and compliance information.
  • Accountability, adaptability, integrity, discretion, and commitment to continuous improvement.

To be considered for the position, you must have:

  • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree, such as a PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or equivalent relevant degree.

Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, RF/wireless, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The RF Designer owns complete RF subsystems on Fidus client programs — from the antenna port through the front-end, frequency conversion and data converters, that present into the DSP and/or FPGA fabric. You will set the RF architecture, build the frequency and sampling plans, design and model the transmit and receive lineups, and prove the performance on the bench, working at microwave frequencies up to 40 GHz.

This role suits an RF designer who has carried subsystems from architecture to characterized, manufacturable hardware, is ready to be the RF authority on a cross-functional team, and works directly with customers — taking pride in designs rigorously modeled before build and rigorously measured after.

Make an Impact with US:

You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout and mechanical/thermal design, delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means SatCom payloads, ground modems and portable terminals; GNSS and precision synchronization; radar and multi-sensor fusion; software defined radios; semiconductor characterization and test fixturing; industrial and private network radios; and medical telemetry.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Define the RF architecture and frequency plan — IF and LO selection, Nyquist zone/sampling plan, clocking, anti-alias/spurious filtering, and line-up specification.
  • Design Tx chains from baseband through up-conversion — drivers, filters, power amplifiers to 10 W, ALC and detector-based output level control, and output protection.
  • Design Rx chains, including digitally intensive sampling architectures — LNA lineups, down-conversion strategy, analog variable gain and AGC, interferer rejection, and input limiting and protection.
  • Model and budget system performance: NF, sensitivity, dynamic range, linearity, EVM, and the LO and clock phase noise and jitter needed to support it.

  • Build-in the features that make a subsystem manufacturable (e.g., factory calibration hooks, digital correction filters, and register access to enable ATE).
  • Verify/characterize performance in the lab using spectrum and signal analyzers, VNAs, vector and analog signal generators, and power meters.
  • Develop technical estimates and risk mitigation strategies, and work closely with clients to produce well-documented, maintainable designs that stand up to review.

Who You Are:

  • Familiarity with FDD and TDD techniques
  • Experience interacting with FPGA, DSP, PCB Layout, and Signal Integrity designers
  • Signal source and clocking design: PLL topology and loop filter design, VCO/DRO and LO multiplier specification, TCXO and VCXO selection, and phase noise and jitter specification and measurement.
  • Filter and microwave component fluency — technology selection across printed, SAW/BAW/FBAR, ceramic resonator, discrete L/C, waveguide and cavity, plus circulators, isolators, couplers, dividers and hybrids — and experience specifying custom parts with vendors.
  • Antenna familiarity: selection, interface specification and vendor management. Antenna element or array design is not required for this role.
  • Expert-level use of RF modeling and simulation tools such as Keysight ADS with non-linear and EM solvers, SystemVue, and MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalents such as Cadence AWR.
  • Hands-on lab capability with microwave test equipment
  • Experience with RF schematic capture, PCB layout collaboration, and RF/microwave component selection, and the ability to debug HW/RF/FPGA integration from schematics and datasheets.
  • Knowledge of various communication and wireless standards
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, with the ability to present technical findings and trade-offs concisely to internal teams and clients.
  • Strong technical judgment with an emphasis on quality and rigor, a willingness to learn new technologies, and readiness for occasional travel (typically within North America) to support client engagements.

Nice to Have:

  • DPD, CFR, and envelope tracking
  • Link budget analysis — terrestrial (with propagation models), MIMO, or orbital SatCom

  • Direct-RF sampling architectures on AMD Zynq RFSoC or Versal devices

About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

jobs.description:
Title:

Director, Enterprise Quality Programs

The Enterprise Director of Quality Programs is a strategic enterprise leader responsible for developing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving the organization's global quality management framework across domestic and international operations. This role supports a diverse portfolio of government, defense, aerospace, engineering, technology, and mission support contracts by ensuring quality programs align with business objectives, customer expectations, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.

The Director provides leadership to assigned and matrixed quality professionals while partnering with business unit leaders, program managers, functional organizations, and executive leadership to foster a culture of quality, operational excellence, accountability, customer focus, risk-based decision making, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will establish enterprise quality strategies, policies, governance processes, standards, and performance measures that support compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, customer-specific requirements, and other applicable regulatory frameworks.

This role requires exceptional strategic thinking, executive presence, organizational agility, and cross-functional leadership to influence stakeholders across multiple business units and geographic regions while balancing corporate governance with operational effectiveness.

Trinzic is being established as an independent public company through the planned separation of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, which is expected to be completed on January 4, 2027. This role offers a rare opportunity to join the organization during a pivotal period of growth and transformation, helping build and advance enterprise quality, compliance, and continuous improvement capabilities that will position the company for long-term success while serving critical government and commercial missions around the world.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise quality vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with corporate objectives and growth initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise-wide quality goals, governance mechanisms, and performance expectations that support business results and customer success.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and continual improvement of the corporate Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Serve as the senior advisor to executive leadership on quality performance, compliance risks, process maturity, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Promote a culture of quality excellence, accountability, customer-focused decision making, and continuous improvement across the enterprise.

Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Excellence

  • Establish and maintain enterprise quality policies, standards, procedures, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements, including ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, customer-specific standards, government contracting requirements, and applicable international frameworks.
  • Lead enterprise readiness activities for certification audits, surveillance audits, recertifications, customer assessments, and regulatory reviews.
  • Direct corrective and preventive action programs arising from audits, assessments, customer findings, or internal evaluations.
  • Monitor emerging industry standards and regulatory developments and ensure timely integration into enterprise processes and governance structures.

Business Partnership & Operational Integration

  • Partner with business unit leadership, program management offices, and functional organizations to deploy enterprise quality initiatives and standards.
  • Provide strategic quality leadership and consultation across government and commercial programs.
  • Balance enterprise standardization with operational flexibility to support diverse customer and business requirements.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and influence decision-making across matrixed and geographically dispersed organizations.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and oversee enterprise quality metrics, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and leading performance indicators.
  • Analyze enterprise quality trends and provide actionable insights to executive leadership.
  • Drive data-informed improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance, strengthen compliance, and reduce business risk.
  • Champion Lean, Six Sigma, process optimization, and operational excellence methodologies across the organization.
  • Advance process maturity, corrective action effectiveness, and enterprise performance improvement initiatives.

Risk Management & Customer Satisfaction

  • Integrate quality and compliance principles into enterprise risk management processes.
  • Evaluate quality-related risks associated with programs, operations, suppliers, and strategic business initiatives.
  • Partner with business leaders to improve customer outcomes, contract performance, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Ensure timely resolution of quality concerns and strengthen customer confidence through proactive engagement and governance.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop assigned quality professionals and matrixed teams.
  • Build organizational capability through training, coaching, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing work environment.
  • Strengthen enterprise quality capability by promoting professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business Administration, Industrial Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • 12-15+ years of progressive experience in quality management, compliance, operational excellence, process improvement, or related disciplines.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing quality programs, teams, and enterprise initiatives within complex, multi-site organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting government, defense, aerospace, engineering, technology, or mission-focused organizations.
  • Experience managing enterprise quality systems across multiple business units, functions, and geographic regions.
  • Proven success leading quality transformation initiatives, compliance programs, audit readiness efforts, and enterprise process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep expertise in ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, and enterprise quality management systems.
  • Strong knowledge of government contracting environments and customer quality requirements.
  • Advanced understanding of quality auditing methodologies, root cause analysis, corrective action management, and process governance.
  • Expertise in risk management, performance measurement, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence methodologies.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking, executive presence, and ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership capabilities, including change leadership, team development, coaching, mentoring, and talent management.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder engagement, matrix management, conflict resolution, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience utilizing enterprise quality management systems, analytics tools, and performance reporting platforms.
  • Strong business acumen, including operational, financial, and customer-focused decision-making capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Quality Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE).
  • ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience supporting government departments, agencies, intelligence community organizations, or international government customers and contracts.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed quality organizations and enterprise-wide quality programs.
  • Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, NIST, and related compliance frameworks.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide process standardization, digital transformation, and business modernization initiatives.

Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

We support career advancement through professional training and development.

These services are considered part of The ProSidian Transport & Logistics Sector Group with overall focus being Transport & Logistics (TLT) Sector Group: Solutions To Move Transport & Logistics Strategy Forward. for clients such as National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA).

JOB OVERVIEW

ProSidian, an innovative management and consulting firm, is seeking a skilled and culturally sensitive Spanish Language Translator to contribute to a transformative initiative focused on comprehending drivers' attitudes and behaviors related to alcohol and non-alcohol drug use. The Spanish Translator will play a vital role in ensuring accurate and effective translation of survey materials between English and Spanish, facilitating inclusive data collection.

The Spanish Translator is a linguistics professional who accurately translates written English into written Spanish, and written Spanish into written English. A translator translates the tone and meaning of a written English survey to a written Spanish survey and interprets any written Spanish comments in written English. A Translator must be proficient enough in both languages to accurately translate between English and Spanish written languages.

As part of a collaborative venture with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), we are seeking a seasoned and adept team member to work on a comprehensive survey project aimed at enhancing road safety and reducing the risks associated with impaired driving. This unique opportunity allows you to play a pivotal role in a research initiative that aligns with our mission to create impactful change. By joining our team, you will spearhead a significant project that has the potential to contribute to safer roadways and improved public safety.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

  • Accurately translate written survey materials from English to Spanish and vice versa, maintaining the tone and meaning of the content.
  • Collaborate closely with the project team to ensure linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance in translated materials.
  • Interpret written Spanish comments in written English, ensuring accurate representation of participant responses.
  • Conduct thorough reviews of translated materials to identify and rectify any linguistic or contextual discrepancies.
  • Contribute to the production of high-quality survey materials, enabling seamless data collection from Spanish-speaking participants.

The Proposal Pricing Analyst is a critical member of the business development and proposal team at 9th Way Insignia.This role is responsible for developing, analyzing, and finalizing cost and pricing proposals in compliance with federal regulations, client requirements, and corporate policies. The successful candidate will ensure pricing strategies align with technical solutions and business goals to enhance the company’s competitive position.

Primary Roles & Responsibilities

  • Pricing Development:
    • Analyze RFPs, RFQs, and other solicitation documents to understand pricing requirements and compliance mandates.
    • Develop detailed cost models and pricing strategies, ensuring alignment with technical proposals.

  • Cost Analysis and Compliance:
    • Perform cost and price analyses to ensure proposals are competitive and compliant with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), and other applicable guidelines.

    • Coordinate with business development team members to ensure integration of pricing with technical and management volumes.
    • Develop supporting documentation, including Basis of Estimates (BOEs), cost narratives, and price-to-win analyses.

  • Process Improvement:
    • Identify and implement best practices and tools to improve pricing strategies and processes.
    • Maintain and update pricing templates and databases to ensure accuracy and efficiency.

Required Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred). Additional experience in lieu of a degree will be considered
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in federal proposal pricing or cost analysis, preferably in the government contracting industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions such as pivot tables, macros, and financial modeling.
  • Understanding of federal contracting regulations, including FAR and DFARS.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.

This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Join the engineering team responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of the Idira Identity Security Management platform (formerly CyberArk), supporting Identity Security Administration (ISA), Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA), Privilege Cloud (pCloud), and Tenant Management (TM).

As a Senior Staff Escalation Engineer, you will investigate the platform's most complex production issues, partnering directly with global R&D teams to identify root causes, drive product improvements, and enhance platform reliability. You will own technical investigations from initial escalation through engineering resolution, collaborating closely with software engineers to diagnose software defects, improve product quality, and strengthen platform resiliency.

This is a hands-on software engineering role - not a traditional support position. Success requires the ability to think like a software engineer while approaching production issues with the curiosity of an investigator. As the engineering escalation point between Technical Support and global R&D, you will help resolve the platform's most technically challenging production issues while influencing product quality, improving operational processes, and helping Engineering build more reliable cloud services.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the highest level of engineering escalation for complex production issues across Identity Security Administration (ISA), Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA), Privilege Cloud, and Tenant Management (TM).

  • Own production investigations from initial escalation through root cause identification and engineering resolution.

  • Reproduce complex production issues and analyze logs, metrics, traces, telemetry, APIs, source code, and system behavior to isolate root causes.

  • Partner directly with global R&D teams to diagnose software defects, validate findings, and drive timely product fixes.

  • Translate investigation findings into actionable engineering defects with clear reproduction steps, log analysis, and supporting evidence.

  • Differentiate among software defects, configuration issues, infrastructure problems, and environmental conditions to ensure accurate ownership.

  • Serve as a technical leader during major production incidents, driving cross-functional collaboration to restore platform stability and prevent recurrence.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product Management, Cloud Operations, and Technical Support to restore platform stability and prevent recurrence.

  • Develop troubleshooting tools, automation, diagnostics, and technical documentation to improve investigation efficiency and operational excellence.

  • Analyze recurring production issues to identify systemic trends and influence long-term product, architectural, and operational improvements.

  • Mentor engineers and share technical expertise across Engineering, R&D, and Technical Support organizations.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting production services.

  • Opportunity to leverage AI-assisted engineering approaches to improve troubleshooting, diagnostics, automation, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

  • This position requires authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship due to customer and regulatory requirements associated with supporting regulated U.S. government cloud environments.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5 + years of extensive experience supporting large-scale enterprise SaaS or cloud-native platforms in Escalation Engineering, Software Engineering, Production Engineering, Sustaining Engineering, or a similar role.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with software engineering and R&D teams to investigate product defects, reproduce issues, isolate root causes, and drive engineering resolution.

  • Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve highly complex production issues beyond the scope of Tier 1 and Tier 2 support organizations.

  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across distributed systems, cloud services, enterprise applications, APIs, and infrastructure.

  • Ability to understand complex SaaS architectures and troubleshoot issues across multiple technology layers.

  • Experience reading, reviewing, or debugging source code and translating production findings into actionable engineering defects.

  • Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills, particularly during high-pressure, critical incidents.

  • Ability to navigate conflicting priorities while driving successful engineering outcomes and maintaining a strong customer focus.

  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation supporting production services.

  • Ability to work remotely within the United States while maintaining regular availability during morning business hours in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone to support collaboration with global R&D teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using AI assisted engineering tools or applying AI/ML

technologies to software development, troubleshooting, automation,

incident investigation, or operational workflows.

Idira Platform Experience (CyberArk)

  • Experience supporting the Idira Identity Security platform (formerly CyberArk), including one or more of the following products:

    • Identity Security Administration (ISA)

    • Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA)

    • Privilege Cloud

    • Tenant Management (TM)

  • Experience with Identity Security, Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), or enterprise cybersecurity solutions.

  • Experience troubleshooting distributed microservices, cloud-native applications, REST APIs, authentication flows, and modern SaaS architectures.

Cloud & Security

  • Hands-on experience with AWS; experience with AWS GovCloud is an advantage.

  • Experience working for a cybersecurity or enterprise security software company.

Tenant Management (TM)

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to create diagnostic tools, automate troubleshooting, and improve operational efficiency.

Secure Infrastructure Access (SIA)

  • Strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, including:

    • User management

    • Authentication and authorization

    • Process management

    • File system management

    • System administration fundamentals

    • Remote access and administration using RDP and SSH

​

Privilege Cloud (pCloud)

  • 3+ years of experience with C#, including the ability to debug new features and legacy code, identify software defects, and support root cause analysis in partnership with R&D.

jobs.excerpt: Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?
jobs.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Syndio is the leader in compensation equity and pay decision intelligence, helping the world's largest employers make fair, defensible, and transparent pay decisions at scale. As Decisions moves to general availability and our enterprise footprint grows, the quantitative depth behind our recommendations has to keep pace.

The Senior Domain Expert (Labor Economics, Statistics, or IO) is a hands-on quantitative practitioner on the Applied Pay Intelligence team. You work directly with our customers and are a senior individual contributor role that leads a small squad. You are the person our customers, our product, and the rest of the team turn to when the methodology has to hold up under scrutiny.

You own an area of Syndio's methodology and asset library, build the 1:many resources that scale your expertise across the customer base, partner directly with Product to embed methodology into Decisions and Essentials, and show up in the customer conversations where the numbers and the reasoning have to be right. You will translate custom analytics into product requirements and support product and development teams as needed on design and implementation plans, partner with the data science and development teams to ensure the product helps advance the outcomes of our total rewards customers.

Why this job is exciting

  • Lead a squad. You will be an individual contributor but you will own an area of Syndio's methodology and content — comparator group logic, regression modeling, remediation methodology, or a related domain. Guide the squad's roadmap, prioritize what gets built, and hold the technical bar for the work that ships.
  • Apply methodology in complex customer situations. Work through the statistical questions customers can't resolve inside the product: unusual workforce structures, small-group modeling, contested comparator choices, novel regulatory tests. Bring the methods, explain the tradeoffs, defend the approach.
  • Build 1:many resources. Turn recurring methodological questions into durable content — customer briefings, methodology guides, model documentation, worked examples — so recurring questions do not require a recurring meeting.
  • Partner with Product. Work directly with Product and AI teams to embed methodology into Decisions and Essentials. Translate quantitative rigor into product logic, review model outputs, catch the edge cases before customers do.
  • Show up for the moments that matter. Anchor customer QBRs, regulatory inflection points, and board-adjacent conversations where the methodology has to hold. Not every meeting — the ones where getting the math and the framing right changes the outcome.
  • Feed the frameworks upward. Surface what current frameworks don't yet cover. Bring specific customer patterns and methodological gaps to the Principal-level colleagues and to Product so the platform's intelligence keeps compounding.

About you

  • 5+ years of hands-on quantitative work in labor economics, statistics, econometrics, industrial-organizational psychology, or a directly related field, applied to compensation, workforce, or pay equity questions.
  • Deep facility with regression modeling and comparator methodology. You can build a defensible pay equity model, explain what it does and does not tell you, and defend the choices behind it in front of a non-technical audience.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate quantitative rigor into language a CHRO, a works council, or a CSM can act on, without losing the substance.
  • Experience embedding methodology into a product, a tool, or a repeatable workflow that other people execute — not just running the analysis yourself.
  • Strong judgment on the difference between what the data supports and what the customer wants it to say, and comfort holding that line.
  • Track record of building content, documentation, or enablement materials that reduce reliance on your calendar over time.
  • Comfort thinking about how quantitative expertise translates into AI-mediated product capability.
  • Experience in HR tech, compensation, people analytics, or a similarly data-intensive enterprise domain is a strong plus.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $143,000 -$160,000 per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise. We take a geo neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success.
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to, plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • Paid parental leave
  • 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.
  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 🏦 401(k). To help you save for your future
  • Fully remote model -

The interview overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Senior Domain Expert position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  • 30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team
  • 45 minute zoom interview with the Hiring Manager (VP Applied Pay Intelligence)
  • 45 minute zoom interview with a Product partner
  • Panel interview with Applied Pay Intelligence team members - 1 hour
  • Final interview with executive - 30 minutes

At Syndio, we're building a diverse team that values candor, curiosity, and community. If you share these values and are interested in joining us, we'd love to talk with you even if you don't 100% meet the "about you" listed here. We don't expect anyone to have all the answers, as long as you're willing to learn and grow with us.

Syndio is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are building an inclusive and collaborative workplace as we grow, and we welcome team members regardless of gender/identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, physical disability and age.

jobs.description:
The Capability Architecture Specialist establishes and administers Fortive's enterprise skills taxonomy, beginning with an externally acquired library and adapting it to the language, roles and strategic capabilities that matter across Fortive. The role is accountable for taxonomy integrity, metadata quality, governance workflows, version control, disciplined change management, and vendor management.

This is a hands-on data stewardship role with meaningful stakeholder influence. The Specialist partners with Talent Partners, HRBPs, HR Operations, HR Technology and subject matter experts to evaluate requests, resolve ambiguity and protect enterprise consistency. The role must be able to explain decisions clearly and challenge unsupported changes while remaining pragmatic and service oriented.

OPERATING MODEL

1 ARCHITECTURE & INTEGRITY2 GOVERNANCE & CHANGE3 ENABLEMENT & ADOPTIONOwn the skills taxonomy structure, standards, metadata and quality.Run transparent intake, review, approval and version-control processes.Help HR teams use the architecture consistently in talent decisions and systems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESESTABLISH AND MAINTAIN THE ENTERPRISE CAPABILITY ARCHITECTURE

  • Stand up Fortive's enterprise skills taxonomy from the ground up using an externally acquired skills library as the starting point.
  • Define the architecture, including domains, categories, skills, definitions, aliases, proficiency descriptors, relationships and required metadata.
  • Create clear design principles and naming standards that balance external market language with Fortive-specific business relevance.
  • Partner with Talent Partners, HRBPs and functional subject matter experts to validate priority skill families and translate business needs into scalable taxonomy updates.
  • Establish the initial baseline, migration approach and release plan, including the treatment of duplicates, legacy terms and local variants.

ADMINISTER TAXONOMY DATA & QUALITY

  • Maintain the authoritative taxonomy record and execute additions, revisions, and archival decisions with precision.
  • Apply data-quality controls to identify duplicates, conflicting definitions, inconsistent levels, missing metadata and broken relationships.
  • Maintain documentation, decision logs, version history and release notes so changes are traceable, explainable and auditable.
  • Coordinate scheduled refreshes using vendor updates, internal demand signals, emerging technology and changing business capability requirements.
  • Prepare clean, structured data files and requirements for configuration or integration by HR Technology and platform owners.

GOVERN REQUESTS & MANAGE STAKEHOLDERS

  • Design and operate a practical intake, triage, review and approval process for taxonomy changes across enterprise and OpCo stakeholders.
  • Evaluate requests against agreed criteria, evidence and enterprise standards rather than stakeholder seniority or local preference.
  • Resolve conflicting requests, recommend the best enterprise solution and escalate only where a genuine policy or strategic decision is required.
  • Respond confidently and constructively to challenge from senior HRBPs and leaders, explaining trade-offs and protecting the usability of the enterprise architecture.
  • Set clear expectations on scope, decision rights, service levels and release timing, and communicate outcomes with transparency and respect.

ENABLE CONSISTENT USE & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

  • Create practical guidance, templates and self-service resources that help HR teams select and apply skills consistently.
  • Support Talent Partners and HRBPs with taxonomy queries and recommendations for workforce planning, talent reviews, capability assessment, career architecture and development use cases.
  • Partner with HR Operations, HR Technology, Talent Acquisition, and Learning to promote consistent use across processes and platforms.
  • Monitor adoption, recurring queries, exception patterns and data-quality indicators to identify opportunities to simplify and improve the architecture.
  • Apply Fortive Business System principles to make governance faster, clearer and more scalable over time.

SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS

OWNSINFLUENCESDOES NOT OWN

  • Enterprise skills taxonomy data and metadata
  • Taxonomy design and naming standards
  • Change intake, quality controls and version history
  • Recommendations on add, change, merge and retire decisions
  • Priority capability and skill families
  • How skills are represented in HR processes and systems
  • External library and vendor requirements
  • Adoption, usability and stakeholder understanding
  • Business or OpCo capability strategy
  • Final business decisions about capability investment
  • HR platforms, integrations or technical configuration
  • Job architecture, compensation architecture or learning content

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, business, information management, data management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in HR Operations, HR data management, HR technology support, job or skills architecture, learning operations, talent operations, knowledge management or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience maintaining structured data, controlled vocabularies, catalogs, taxonomies, master data or similarly governed content.
  • Strong data-management discipline, including attention to detail, data validation, documentation, version control and process compliance.
  • Ability to learn complex frameworks quickly, identify patterns and translate ambiguous requests into precise, scalable data solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment and confidence to explain decisions, hold boundaries and manage disagreement with senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated customer orientation and practical problem solving, balancing enterprise standards with legitimate business needs.
  • Experience working with a commercial skills library, skills intelligence platform or job architecture is preferred but not required.

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

jobs.title: Release Manager
jobs.excerpt: Zaelab is looking for a Release Manager to own and drive the software release process for a key client engagement.
jobs.description:
Zaelab is looking for a Release Manager to own and drive the software release process for a key client engagement.

In this role, you’ll bring structure, visibility, and predictability to how software moves into production. You’ll own the release process from planning and readiness through go-live and post-release stabilization, working across engineering, QA, DevOps, project teams, and client stakeholders to make sure everyone is aligned and releases happen smoothly.

This is not a hands-on development role. We’re looking for someone who understands the technical side of software delivery but thrives in the orchestration of it — connecting teams, anticipating risks, keeping dependencies moving, and making sure there is a clear plan when things don’t go as expected.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the release calendar — Build and manage the release schedule across the engagement, coordinating dependencies, freeze windows, environments, and competing workstreams.
  • Drive release readiness — Establish clear entry and exit criteria, facilitate go/no-go discussions, and ensure the right approvals are in place across engineering, QA, security, and client teams.
  • Lead cutover planning — Create detailed, actionable cutover plans with clear owners, timing, dependencies, and checkpoints. Coordinate dry runs and rehearsals for higher-risk releases.
  • Ensure rollback readiness — Make sure releases have documented and tested rollback plans, with clear triggers and decision ownership established before deployment.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned — Own release communications before, during, and after deployment, adapting the level of detail for technical teams, leadership, and client stakeholders.
  • Identify and manage risk — Surface potential blockers early, whether they’re related to testing, environments, dependencies, or timing, and bring forward clear mitigation options.
  • Improve how we release — Track release performance and trends, lead retrospectives, and continuously improve the processes that help teams ship reliably.
  • Partner with DevOps — Work closely with DevOps teams around deployment automation, environments, branching, and versioning. You won’t be expected to build pipelines, but you should understand how they work and how they impact release planning.

What You Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in release management, delivery management, technical program management, or a similar role within software delivery.
  • Hands-on experience managing production releases end to end, including planning, readiness, go/no-go, cutover, and rollback.
  • Strong understanding of the SDLC, CI/CD concepts, deployment environments, and branching/versioning strategies.
  • Experience coordinating across engineering, QA, DevOps, project teams, and external or client stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear runbooks, release updates, and executive-level summaries.
  • A structured, calm approach to decision-making, particularly during high-pressure releases or production issues.
  • Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, release workflows, and delivery dashboards.
  • Active use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot to work more effectively — whether creating release documentation, summarizing information, drafting communications, or improving workflows — combined with good judgment around validating AI-generated output.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working in eCommerce environments.
  • Exposure to CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) solutions.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • ServiceNow experience.
  • Experience working in consulting, professional services, or another client-facing delivery environment.
  • ITIL, SAFe Release Train Engineer, PMP, or similar certification.

What success looks like:

You create clarity around releases before they happen. Teams know what is shipping, when it is shipping, who owns each step, what could go wrong, and what the plan is if it does.

You’re proactive rather than reactive, comfortable working across technical and business teams, and able to bring structure to complex client environments without adding unnecessary process.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in release management, delivery management, technical program management, or a similar role within software delivery.
  • Hands-on experience managing production releases end to end, including planning, readiness, go/no-go, cutover, and rollback.
  • Strong understanding of the SDLC, CI/CD concepts, deployment environments, and branching/versioning strategies.
  • Experience coordinating across engineering, QA, DevOps, project teams, and external or client stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear runbooks, release updates, and executive-level summaries.
  • A structured, calm approach to decision-making, particularly during high-pressure releases or production issues.
  • Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence, release workflows, and delivery dashboards.
  • Active use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot to work more effectively — whether creating release documentation, summarizing information, drafting communications, or improving workflows — combined with good judgment around validating AI-generated output.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in eCommerce environments.
  • Exposure to CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) solutions.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • ServiceNow experience.
  • Experience working in consulting, professional services, or another client-facing delivery environment.
